gotten ind i him a mess of broken victuals eller a platter of tripes med a
bare tester in his purse han kunne altid bring himself off med his
tongue, nogle randy quip han havde fra a punk eller whatnot that hver
mor’s søn of them would burst their sides. The other, Costello that
is, hearing this talk asked was it poetry eller a tale. Faith, nej, he
says, Frank (that was his name), ’tis alle om Kerry cows that are to
be butchered along af den plague. men they can go hang, says he med a
wink, for me med their bully beef, a pox on it. der’s as gud fish
in this tin as ever came ud of it og meget friendly he offered to take
of nogle salty sprats that stood by which han havde eyed wishly i den
meantime og found the place which was indeed the chief design of his
embassy as han var sharpset. _Mort aux vaches_, says Frank så i den
French language that had been indentured to a brandyshipper that has a
winelodge in Bordeaux og he spoke French som a gentleman også. fra a
barn this Frank had been a donought that his far, a headborough,
hvem could ill keep him to school to learn his letters og the use of
the globes, matriculated ved den university to study the mechanics men
han tog the bit between his teeth som a raw colt og was mere familiar
med den justiciary og the parish beadle than med his volumes. One
tid han ville be a playactor, så a sutler eller a welsher, så nought
would keep him fra den bearpit og the cocking main, så han var for
the ocean hav eller to hoof it på den roads med den romany folk,
kidnapping a squire’s heir by favour of moonlight eller fecking maids’
linen eller choking chicken behind a hedge. han havde been off as mange times
as a cat has lives og back igen med naked pockets as mange mere to
his far the headborough hvem shed a pint of tears as ofte as han så
him. hvad, says Mr Leopold med his hands across, that was earnest to
know the drift of it, will they slaughter alle? I protest jeg så them men
this dag morning going til den Liverpool boats, says he. I can scarce
believe ’tis so dårlig, says he. og han havde experience af den som brood
beasts og of springers, greasy hoggets og wether wool, having been
nogle years før actuary for Mr Joseph Cuffe, a worthy salesmaster
that drove his trade for live stock og meadow auctions hard by Mr
Gavin Low’s yard in Prussia gade. I question med you der, says he.
mere som ’tis the hoose eller the timber tongue. Mr Stephen, a lille
moved men meget handsomely told him nej such matter og that han havde
dispatches fra den emperor’s chief tailtickler thanking him for the
hospitality, that was sending over Doctor Rinderpest, the bestquoted
cowcatcher in alle Muscovy, med a bolus eller two of physic to take the
bull ved den horns. Come, come, says Mr Vincent, plain dealing. He’ll
find himself på den horns of a dilemma if he meddles med a bull that’s
Irish, says he. Irish by name og irish by nature, says Mr Stephen, og
he sent the ale purling om, an Irish bull in an English chinashop. I
conceive you, says Mr Dixon. It is that same bull that was sent to our
island by farmer Nicholas, the bravest cattlebreeder of them alle, med
an emerald ring in his nose. sandt for you, says Mr Vincent cross the
table, og a bullseye ind i den bargain, says he, og a plumper og a
portlier bull, says he, aldrig shit on shamrock. han havde horns galore, a
coat of cloth of gold og a sweet smoky breath coming ud of his
nostrils so that the women of our island, leaving doughballs og
rollingpins, followed efter him hanging his bulliness in daisychains.
hvad for that, says Mr Dixon, men før han kom over farmer Nicholas
that was a eunuch had him properly gelded by a college of doctors hvem
were nej better off than himself. So be off nu, says he, og do alle my
cousin german the lord Harry tells you og take a farmer’s blessing,
og med that he slapped his posteriors meget soundly. men the slap og
the blessing stood him ven, says Mr Vincent, for to make up he
taught him a trick worth two af den other so that maid, wife, abbess
og widow to this dag affirm that they would rather any tid af den
month whisper in his ear i den mørk of a cowhouse eller get a lick på den
nape fra his lang holy tongue than lie med den finest strapping young
ravisher i den four fields of alle Ireland. Another så put in his
word: og they dressed him, says he, in a point shift og petticoat
med a tippet og girdle og ruffles on his wrists og clipped his
forelock og rubbed him alle over med spermacetic oil og built stables
for him at hver turn af den road med a gold manger in each full of
the best hay i den market so that han kunne doss og dung to his
hjerte’s content. By this tid the far af den faithful (for so they
called him) was grown so heavy that han kunne scarce walk to pasture. To
remedy which our cozening dames og damsels brought him his fodder in
their apronlaps og as soon as his belly was full han ville rear up on
his hind quarters to show their ladyships a mystery og roar og bellow
ud of him in bulls’ language og they alle efter him. Ay, says another,
og so pampered was he that han ville suffer nought to grow in alle the
land men green grass for himself (for that was the kun colour to his
sind) og der var a board put up on a hillock i den middle af den
island med a printed notice, saying: ved den Lord Harry, Green is the
grass that grows på den ground. og, says Mr Dixon, if ever han fik
scent of a cattleraider in Roscommon eller the wilds of Connemara eller a
husbandman in Sligo that was sowing as meget as a handful of mustard eller
a bag of rapeseed ud he’d run amok over half the countryside rooting
up med his horns whatever was planted og alle by lord Harry’s orders.
der var dårlig blood between them at first, says Mr Vincent, og the
lord Harry called farmer Nicholas alle the gammel Nicks i den verden og an
gammel whoremaster that kept seven trulls in his hus og I’ll meddle in
his matters, says he. I’ll make that animal smell hell, says he, med
the help of that gud pizzle my far left me. men one evening, says
Mr Dixon, da the lord Harry was cleaning his royal pelt to go to
dinner efter winning a boatrace (han havde spade oars for himself men the
first rule af den course was that the others were to row med
pitchforks) he discovered in himself a wonderful likeness to a bull og
on picking up a blackthumbed chapbook that he kept i den pantry he
found sure enough that han var a lefthanded descendant af den famous
champion bull af den Romans, _Bos Bovum_, which is gud bog Latin for
boss af den show. efter that, says Mr Vincent, the lord Harry put his
hoved ind i a cow’s drinkingtrough i den presence of alle his courtiers
og pulling it ud igen told them alle his ny name. så, med den
vand running off him, han fik ind i an gammel smock og skirt that had
belonged to his grandmother og bought a grammar af den bulls’ language
to study men han kunne aldrig learn a word of it except the first
personal pronoun which he copied ud stor og got off by hjerte og if
ever han gik ud for a walk he filled his pockets med chalk to write
it upon hvad took his fancy, the side of a rock eller a teahouse table eller
a bale of cotton eller a corkfloat. In short, he og the bull of Ireland
were soon as fast friends as an arse og a shirt. de var, says Mr
Stephen, og the end was that the men af den island seeing nej help was
toward, as the ungrate women were alle of one sind, made a wherry raft,
loaded themselves og their bundles of chattels on shipboard, set alle
masts erect, manned the yards, sprang their luff, heaved to, spread
three sheets i den vind, put her hoved between vind og vand, weighed
anchor, ported her helm, ran up the jolly Roger, gave three times
three, let the bullgine run, pushed off in their bumboat og put to hav
to recover the main of America. Which was the occasion, says Mr
Vincent, af den composing by a boatswain of that rollicking chanty:
_—Pope Peter’s men a pissabed.
A mand’s a mand for a’ that._

Our worthy acquaintance Mr Malachi Mulligan nu appeared i den doorway
as the students were finishing their apologue accompanied med a ven
whom han havde bare rencountered, a young gentleman, his name Alec Bannon,
hvem had late come to town, it being his intention to buy a colour eller a
cornetcy i den fencibles og list for the wars. Mr Mulligan was civil
enough to express nogle relish of it alle the mere as it jumped med a
project of his own for the cure af den meget evil that had been touched
on. Whereat he handed round til den company a set of pasteboard cards
which han havde had printed that dag at Mr Quinnell’s bearing a legend
printed in fair italics: _Mr Malachi Mulligan. Fertiliser og
Incubator. Lambay Island_. His project, as han gik on to expound, was
to withdraw fra den round of idle pleasures such as form the chief
business of sir Fopling Popinjay og sir Milksop Quidnunc in town og
to devote himself til den noblest task for which our bodily organism has
been framed. Well, let us hear of it, gud my ven, said Mr Dixon. I
make nej doubt it smacks of wenching. Come, be seated, both. ’Tis as
cheap sitting as standing. Mr Mulligan accepted af den invitation og,
expatiating upon his design, told his hearers that han havde been led ind i
this thought by a consideration af den causes of sterility, both the
inhibitory og the prohibitory, whether the inhibition in its turn were
due to conjugal vexations eller to a parsimony af den balance as well as
whether the prohibition proceeded fra defects congenital eller fra
proclivities acquired. It grieved him plaguily, sagde han, to see the
nuptial couch defrauded of its dearest pledges: og to reflect upon so
mange agreeable females med rich jointures, a prey til den vilest
bonzes, hvem hide their flambeau under a bushel in an uncongenial
cloister eller lose their womanly bloom i den embraces of nogle
unaccountable muskin da they might multiply the inlets of happiness,
sacrificing the inestimable jewel of their sex da a hundred pretty
fellows were at hånd to caress, this, he assured them, made his hjerte
weep. To curb this inconvenient (which he concluded due to a
suppression of latent heat), having advised med certain counsellors of
worth og inspected ind i this matter, han havde resolved to purchase in
fee simple for ever the freehold of Lambay island fra its holder, lord
Talbot de Malahide, a Tory gentleman of note meget in favour med our
ascendancy party. He proposed to set up der a national fertilising
farm to be named _Omphalos_ med an obelisk hewn og erected efter the
fashion of Egypt og to offer his dutiful yeoman services for the
fecundation of any female of hvad grade of liv soever hvem should der
direct to him med den desire of fulfilling the functions of her
natural. Money was nej object, sagde han, nor would he take a penny for
his pains. The poorest kitchenwench nej less than the opulent lady of
fashion, if so be their constructions og their tempers were warm
persuaders for their petitions, would find in him their mand. For his
nutriment he shewed hvordan han ville feed himself exclusively upon a diet
of savoury tubercles og fish og coneys der, the flesh of these
latter prolific rodents being highly recommended for his purpose, both
broiled og stewed med a blade of mace og a pod eller two of capsicum
chillies. efter this homily which he delivered med meget warmth of
asseveration Mr Mulligan in a trice put off fra his hat a kerchief
med which han havde shielded it. They both, it seems, had been overtaken
ved den regn og for alle their mending their pace had taken vand, as
might be observed by Mr Mulligan’s smallclothes of a hodden grey which
was nu somewhat piebald. His project meanwhile was meget favourably
entertained by his auditors og won hearty eulogies fra alle though Mr
Dixon of Mary’s excepted to it, asking med a finicking air did he
purpose also to carry coals to Newcastle. Mr Mulligan however made
court til den scholarly by an apt quotation fra den classics which, as
it dwelt upon his memory, seemed to him a sound og tasteful support of
his contention: _Talis ac tanta depravatio hujus seculi, O quirites, ut
matresfamiliarum nostrae lascivas cujuslibet semiviri libici
titillationes testibus ponderosis atque excelsis erectionibus
centurionum Romanorum magnopere anteponunt_, while for those of ruder
wit he drove hjem his point by analogies af den animal kingdom mere
suitable to their stomach, the buck og doe af den forest glade, the
farmyard drake og duck.

Valuing himself ikke a lille upon his elegance, being indeed a proper
mand of person, this talkative nu applied himself to his dress med
animadversions of nogle heat upon the sudden whimsy af den atmospherics
while the company lavished their encomiums upon the project han havde
advanced. The young gentleman, his ven, overjoyed as han var at a
passage that had late befallen him, kunne ikke forbear to tell it his
nearest neighbour. Mr Mulligan, nu perceiving the table, asked for
whom were those loaves og fishes og, seeing the stranger, han lavede him
a civil bow og said, Pray, sir, was you in need of any professional
assistance we could give? hvem, upon his offer, thanked him meget
heartily, though preserving his proper distance, og replied that he
was come der om a lady, nu an inmate of Horne’s hus, that was
in an interesting condition, poor krop, fra kvinde’s woe (og her he
fetched a deep sigh) to know if her happiness had yet taken place. Mr
Dixon, to turn the table, took on to ask of Mr Mulligan himself whether
his incipient ventripotence, upon which he rallied him, betokened an
ovoblastic gestation i den prostatic utricle eller male womb eller was due,
as med den noted physician, Mr Austin Meldon, to a wolf i den
stomach. For answer Mr Mulligan, in a gale of laughter at his smalls,
smote himself bravely below the diaphragm, exclaiming med an admirable
droll mimic of mor Grogan (the mest excellent creature of her sex
though ’tis pity she’s a trollop): der’s a belly that aldrig bore a
bastard. This was so happy a conceit that it renewed the storm of mirth
og threw the whole rum ind i den mest violent agitations of delight.
The spry rattle had run on i den same vein of mimicry men for nogle
larum i den antechamber.

her the listener hvem was none other than the Scotch student, a lille
fume of a fellow, blond as tow, congratulated i den liveliest fashion
med den young gentleman og, interrupting the narrative at a salient
point, having desired his visavis med a polite beck to have the
obligingness to pass him a flagon of cordial waters ved den same tid by
a questioning poise af den hoved (a whole century of polite breeding had
ikke achieved so nice a gesture) to which was united an equivalent men
contrary balance af den bottle asked the narrator as plainly as was
ever done in words if he might treat him med a cup of it. _Mais bien
sûr_, noble stranger, said he cheerily, _et mille compliments_. That
you may og meget opportunely. der wanted ingenting men this cup to
crown my felicity. men, gracious heaven, was I left med men a crust in
my wallet og a cupful of vand fra den well, my gud, jeg ville accept
of them og find it in my hjerte to kneel down upon the ground og give
thanks til den powers above for the happiness vouchsafed me ved den Giver
of gud things. med these words he approached the goblet to his lips,
took a complacent draught af den cordial, slicked his hair og, opening
his bosom, ud popped a locket that hung fra a silk riband, that meget
picture which han havde cherished ever since her hånd had wrote therein.
Gazing upon those features med a verden of tenderness, Ah, Monsieur, he
said, had you men beheld her as I did med these øjne at that affecting
instant med her dainty tucker og her ny coquette cap (a gift for her
feastday as she told me prettily) in such an artless disorder, of so
melting a tenderness, ’pon my conscience, endda you, Monsieur, had been
impelled by generous nature to deliver yourself wholly ind i den hands
of such an enemy eller to quit the field for ever. I declare, jeg var aldrig
so touched in alle my liv. gud, I thank thee, as the Author of my days!
Thrice happy will he be whom so amiable a creature will bless med her
favours. A sigh of affection gave eloquence to these words og, having
replaced the locket in his bosom, he wiped his øje og sighed igen.
Beneficent Disseminator of blessings to alle Thy creatures, hvordan great
og universal must be that sweetest of Thy tyrannies which can hold in
thrall the free og the bond, the simple swain og the polished
coxcomb, the lover i den heyday of reckless passion og the husband of
maturer years. men indeed, sir, I wander fra den point. hvordan mingled
og imperfect are alle our sublunary joys. Maledicity! he exclaimed in
anguish. Would to gud that foresight had men remembered me to take my
cloak along! jeg kunne weep to think of it. så, though it had poured
seven showers, we were neither of us a penny the worse. men beshrew me,
he cried, clapping hånd to his forehead, tomorrow will be a ny dag
og, thousand thunders, jeg ved of a _marchand de capotes_, Monsieur
Poyntz, fra whom I can have for a _livre_ as snug a cloak af den
French fashion as ever kept a lady fra wetting. Tut, tut! cries Le
Fécondateur, tripping in, my ven Monsieur Moore, that mest
accomplished traveller (jeg har bare cracked a half bottle _avec lui_ in
a circle af den best wits af den town), is my authority that in Cape
Horn, _ventre biche_, they have a regn that will wet through any, endda
the stoutest cloak. A drenching of that violence, he tells me, _sans
blague_, has sent mere than one luckless fellow in gud earnest
posthaste to another verden. Pooh! A _livre!_ cries Monsieur Lynch. The
clumsy things are dear at a sou. One umbrella, were it nej bigger than a
fairy mushroom, is worth ten such stopgaps. nej kvinde of any wit would
wear one. My dear Kitty told me today that hun ville dance in a deluge
før ever hun ville starve in such an ark of salvation for, as she
reminded me (blushing piquantly og whispering in my ear though der
was none to snap her words men giddy butterflies), dame Nature, ved den
divine blessing, has implanted it in our hearts og it has become a
household word that _il y a deux choses_ for which the innocence of our
original garb, in other circumstances a breach af den proprieties, is
the fittest, nay, the kun garment. The first, said she (og her my
pretty philosopher, as I handed her to her tilbury, to fix my
attention, gently tipped med her tongue the outer chamber of my ear),
the first is a bath... men at this point a bell tinkling i den hall
cut short a discourse which promised so bravely for the enrichment of
our store of knowledge.

Amid the general vacant hilarity af den assembly a bell rang og, while
alle were conjecturing hvad might be the cause, Miss Callan entered og,
having spoken a få words in a low tone to young Mr Dixon, retired med
a profound bow til den company. The presence endda for a moment among a
party of debauchees of a kvinde endued med hver quality of modesty og
ikke less severe than beautiful refrained the humourous sallies endda of
the mest licentious men her departure was the signal for an outbreak of
ribaldry. Strike me silly, said Costello, a low fellow hvem was fuddled.
A monstrous fine bit of cowflesh! I’ll be sworn she has rendezvoused
you. hvad, you dog? Have you a way med them? Gad’s bud, immensely so,
said Mr Lynch. The bedside manner it is that they use i den Mater
hospice. Demme, does ikke Doctor O’Gargle chuck the nuns der under the
chin. As I look to be saved jeg havde it fra my Kitty hvem has been
wardmaid der any tid these seven months. Lawksamercy, doctor, cried
the young blood i den primrose vest, feigning a womanish simper og
med immodest squirmings of his krop, hvordan you do tease a krop! Drat the
mand! Bless me, I’m alle of a wibbly wobbly. hvorfor, you’re as dårlig as dear
lille far Cantekissem, that you are! May this pot of four half
choke me, cried Costello, if she aint i den family way. I knows a lady
hvad’s got a white swelling quick as I claps øjne on her. The young
surgeon, however, rose og begged the company to excuse his retreat as
the nurse had bare så informed him that han var needed i den ward.
Merciful providence had been pleased to put a period til den sufferings
af den lady hvem was _enceinte_ which hun havde borne med a laudable
fortitude og hun havde given birth to a bouncing dreng. I want patience,
said he, med those hvem, without wit to enliven eller learning to
instruct, revile an ennobling profession which, saving the reverence
due til den Deity, is the greatest power for happiness upon the jord. I
am positive da I say that if need were jeg kunne produce a cloud of
witnesses til den excellence of her noble exercitations which, so far
fra being a byword, should be a glorious incentive i den human
breast. I cannot away med them. hvad? Malign such an one, the amiable
Miss Callan, hvem is the lustre of her own sex og the astonishment of
ours? og at an instant the mest momentous that can befall a puny barn
of clay? Perish the thought! I shudder to think af den future of a race
hvor the seeds of such malice have been sown og hvor nej right
reverence is rendered to mor og maid in hus of Horne. Having
delivered himself of this rebuke he saluted those present på den by og
repaired til den dør. A murmur of approval arose fra alle og nogle were
for ejecting the low soaker without mere ado, a design which would have
been effected nor would he have received mere than his bare deserts had
he ikke abridged his transgression by affirming med a horrid
imprecation (for he swore a round hånd) that han var as gud a søn of
the sandt fold as ever drew breath. Stap my vitals, said he, them was
altid the sentiments of honest Frank Costello which jeg var bred up mest
particular to honour thy far og thy mor that had the best hånd
to a rolypoly eller a hasty pudding as you ever see hvad I altid looks
back on med a loving hjerte.

To revert to Mr Bloom hvem, efter his first entry, had been conscious of
nogle impudent mocks which he however had borne med as being the fruits
of that age upon which it is commonly charged that it knows ikke pity.
The young sparks, it is sandt, were as full of extravagancies as
overgrown children: the words of their tumultuary discussions were
difficultly understood og ikke ofte nice: their testiness og
outrageous _mots_ were such that his intellects resiled fra: nor were
they scrupulously sensible af den proprieties though their fund of
strong animal spirits spoke in their behalf. men the word of Mr
Costello was an unwelcome language for him for he nauseated the wretch
that seemed to him a cropeared creature of a misshapen gibbosity, born
ud of wedlock og thrust som a crookback toothed og feet first ind i
the verden, which the dint af den surgeon’s pliers in his skull lent
indeed a colour to, so as to put him in thought of that missing link of
creation’s chain desiderated ved den late ingenious Mr Darwin. det var
nu for mere than the middle span of our allotted years that han havde
passed gennem den thousand vicissitudes of existence og, being of a
wary ascendancy og self a mand of rare forecast, han havde enjoined his
hjerte to repress alle motions of a rising choler og, by intercepting
them med den readiest precaution, foster within his breast that
plenitude of sufferance which base minds jeer at, rash judgers scorn
og alle find tolerable og men tolerable. To those hvem create
themselves wits ved den cost of feminine delicacy (a habit of sind which
he aldrig did hold med) to them han ville concede neither to bear the
name nor to herit the tradition of a proper breeding: while for such
that, having lost alle forbearance, can lose nej mere, der remained the
sharp antidote of experience to cause their insolency to beat a
precipitate og inglorious retreat. ikke men hvad han kunne feel med
mettlesome youth which, caring nought for the mows of dotards eller the
gruntlings af den severe, is ever (as the chaste fancy af den Holy
Writer expresses it) for eating af den træ forbid it yet ikke so far
forth as to pretermit humanity upon any condition soever towards a
gentlewoman da hun var om her lawful occasions. To conclude, while
fra den søster’s words han havde reckoned upon a speedy delivery han var,
however, it must be owned, ikke a lille alleviated ved den intelligence
that the issue so auspicated efter an ordeal of such duress nu
testified once mere til den mercy as well as til den bounty af den
Supreme Being.

Accordingly he broke his sind to his neighbour, saying that, to express
his notion af den thing, his opinion (hvem ought ikke perchance to
express one) was that one must have a cold constitution og a frigid
genius ikke to be rejoiced by this freshest news af den fruition of her
confinement since hun havde been in such pain through nej fault of hers.
The dressy young blade said det var her husband’s that put her in that
expectation eller at least it ought to be unless she were another Ephesian
matron. I must acquaint you, said Mr Crotthers, clapping på den table
so as to evoke a resonant comment of emphasis, gammel Glory Allelujurum
was round igen today, an elderly mand med dundrearies, preferring
through his nose a request to have word of Wilhelmina, my liv, as he
calls her. I bade him hold himself in readiness for that the event
would burst anon. ’Slife, I’ll be round med you. I cannot men extol
the virile potency af den gammel bucko that could stadig knock another
barn ud of her. alle fell to praising of it, each efter his own
fashion, though the same young blade held med his former view that
another than her conjugial had been the mand i den gap, a clerk in
orders, a linkboy (virtuous) eller an itinerant vendor of articles needed
in hver household. Singular, communed the guest med himself, the
wonderfully unequal faculty of metempsychosis possessed by them, that
the puerperal dormitory og the dissecting theatre should be the
seminaries of such frivolity, that the mere acquisition of academic
titles should suffice to transform in a pinch of tid these votaries of
levity ind i exemplary practitioners of an art which mest men anywise
eminent have esteemed the noblest. men, he further added, it is mayhap
to relieve the pentup feelings that in common oppress them for jeg har
mere than once observed that birds of a feather laugh together.

men med hvad fitness, let it be asked af den noble lord, his patron,
has this alien, whom the concession of a gracious prince has admitted
to civic rights, constituted himself the lord paramount of our internal
polity? hvor is nu that gratitude which loyalty should have
counselled? During the recent war whenever the enemy had a temporary
advantage med his granados did this traitor to his kind ikke seize that
moment to discharge his piece against the empire of which he is a
tenant at will while he trembled for the security of his four per
cents? Has he forgotten this as he forgets alle benefits received? eller is
it that fra being a deluder of others he has become at last his own
dupe as he is, if report belie him ikke, his own og his kun enjoyer?
Far be it fra candour to violate the bedchamber of a respectable lady,
the datter of a gallant major, eller to cast the mest distant
reflections upon her virtue men if he challenges attention der (as it
was indeed highly his interest ikke to have done) så be it so. Unhappy
kvinde, she has been også lang og også persistently denied her legitimate
prerogative to listen to his objurgations med any other feeling than
the derision af den desperate. He says this, a censor of morals, a meget
pelican in his piety, hvem gjorde ikke scruple, oblivious af den ties of
nature, to attempt illicit intercourse med a female domestic drawn
fra den lowest strata of society! Nay, had the hussy’s scouringbrush
ikke been her tutelary angel, it had gone med her as hard as med
Hagar, the Egyptian! i den question af den grazing lands his peevish
asperity is notorious og in Mr Cuffe’s hearing brought upon him fra
an indignant rancher a scathing retort couched in terms as
straightforward as de var bucolic. It ill becomes him to preach that
gospel. Has he ikke nearer hjem a seedfield that lies fallow for the
want af den ploughshare? A habit reprehensible at puberty is second
nature og an opprobrium in middle liv. If he must dispense his balm
of Gilead in nostrums og apothegms of dubious taste to restore to
health a generation of unfledged profligates let his practice consist
better med den doctrines that nu engross him. His marital breast is
the repository of secrets which decorum is reluctant to adduce. The
lewd suggestions of nogle faded beauty may console him for a consort
neglected og debauched men this ny exponent of morals og healer of
ills is at his best an exotic træ which, da rooted in its native
orient, throve og flourished og was abundant in balm men,
transplanted to a clime mere temperate, its roots have lost their
quondam vigour while the stuff that comes away fra it is stagnant,
acid og inoperative.

The mystery was unveiled. Haines was the third bror. His real name

hvad is the age af den sjæl of mand? As she hath the virtue af den
chameleon to change her hue at hver ny approach, to be gay med den

young Leopold. der, as in a retrospective arrangement, a mirror
within a mirror (hey, presto!), he beholdeth himself. That young figure
of så is seen, precociously manly, walking on a nipping morning fra
the gammel hus in Clanbrassil gade til den high school, his booksatchel
on him bandolierwise, og in it a goodly hunk of wheaten loaf, a
mor’s thought. eller it is the same figure, a year eller so gone over, in
his first hard hat (ah, that was a dag!), allerede på den road, a
fullfledged traveller for the family firm, equipped med an orderbook,
a scented handkerchief (ikke for show kun), his case of bright
trinketware (alas! a thing nu af den past!) og a quiverful of
compliant smiles for this eller that halfwon housewife reckoning it ud
upon her fingertips eller for a budding virgin, shyly acknowledging (men
the hjerte? tell me!) his studied baisemoins. The scent, the smile, men,
mere than these, the mørk øjne og oleaginous address, brought hjem at
duskfall mange a commission til den hoved af den firm, seated med Jacob’s
pipe efter som labours i den paternal ingle (a meal of noodles, you
may be sure, is aheating), reading through round horned spectacles nogle
paper fra den Europe of a month før. men hey, presto, the mirror is
breathed on og the young knighterrant recedes, shrivels, dwindles to a
tiny speck within the mist. nu he is himself paternal og these om
him might be his sons. hvem can say? The wise far knows his own
barn. He thinks of a drizzling nat in Hatch gade, hard ved den
bonded stores der, the first. Together (she is a poor waif, a barn
of shame, yours og mine og of alle for a bare shilling og her
luckpenny), together they hear the heavy tread af den watch as two
raincaped shadows pass the ny royal university. Bridie! Bridie Kelly!
He will aldrig forget the name, ever remember the nat: first nat,
the bridenight. They are entwined in nethermost darkness, the willer
med den willed, og in an instant (_fiat!_) lys shall flood the
verden. Did hjerte leap to hjerte? Nay, fair reader. In a breath ’twas
done men—hold! Back! It må ikke be! In terror the poor pige flees away
gennem den murk. She is the bride of darkness, a datter of nat.
She dare ikke bear the sunnygolden babe of dag. nej, Leopold. Name og
memory solace thee ikke. That youthful illusion of thy strength was
taken fra thee—og in vain. nej søn of thy loins is by thee. der is
none nu to be for Leopold, hvad Leopold was for Rudolph.

The voices blend og fuse in clouded silence: silence that is the
infinite of space: og swiftly, silently the sjæl is wafted over
regions of cycles of generations that have lived. A region hvor grey
twilight ever descends, aldrig falls on wide sagegreen pasturefields,
shedding her dusk, scattering a perennial dew of stjerner. She follows her
mor med ungainly steps, a mare leading her fillyfoal. Twilight
phantoms are they, yet moulded in prophetic grace of structure, slim
shapely haunches, a supple tendonous neck, the meek apprehensive skull.
They fade, sad phantoms: alle is gone. Agendath is a waste land, a hjem
of screechowls og the sandblind upupa. Netaim, the golden, is nej mere.
og på den highway af den clouds they come, muttering thunder of
rebellion, the ghosts of beasts. Huuh! Hark! Huuh! Parallax stalks
behind og goads them, the lancinating lightnings of whose brow are
scorpions. Elk og yak, the bulls of Bashan og of Babylon, mammoth og
mastodon, they come trooping til den sunken hav, _Lacus Mortis_. Ominous
revengeful zodiacal host! They moan, passing upon the clouds, horned
og capricorned, the trumpeted med den tusked, the lionmaned, the
giantantlered, snouter og crawler, rodent, ruminant og pachyderm, alle
their moving moaning multitude, murderers af den sol.

Onward til den dead hav they tramp to drink, unslaked og med horrible
gulpings, the salt somnolent inexhaustible flood. og the equine
portent grows igen, magnified i den deserted heavens, nay to heaven’s
own magnitude, till it looms, vast, over the hus of Virgo. og lo,
wonder of metempsychosis, it is she, the everlasting bride, harbinger
af den daystar, the bride, ever virgin. It is she, Martha, thou lost
one, Millicent, the young, the dear, the radiant. hvordan serene does she
nu arise, a queen among the Pleiades, i den penultimate antelucan
hour, shod in sandals of bright gold, coifed med a veil of hvad do you
call it gossamer. It floats, it flows om her starborn flesh og
loose it streams, emerald, sapphire, mauve og heliotrope, sustained on
currents af den cold interstellar vind, winding, coiling, simply
swirling, writhing i den skies a mysterious writing till, efter a
myriad metamorphoses of symbol, it blazes, Alpha, a ruby og triangled
sign upon the forehead of Taurus.

alle could see hvordan hard det var for him to be reminded of his promise og

The debate which ensued was in its scope og progress an epitome af den
course of liv. Neither place nor council was lacking in dignity. The
debaters were the keenest i den land, the theme de var engaged on
the loftiest og mest vital. The high hall of Horne’s hus had aldrig
beheld an assembly so representative og so varied nor had the gammel
rafters of that establishment ever listened to a language so
encyclopaedic. A gallant scene in truth it made. Crotthers was der at
the foot af den table in his striking Highland garb, his ansigt glowing
fra den briny airs af den Mull of Galloway. der også, opposite to
him, was Lynch whose countenance bore allerede the stigmata of early
depravity og premature wisdom. Next the Scotchman was the place
assigned to Costello, the eccentric, while at his side was seated in
stolid repose the squat form of Madden. The chair af den resident
indeed stood vacant før the hearth men on either flank of it the
figure of Bannon in explorer’s kit of tweed shorts og salted cowhide
brogues contrasted sharply med den primrose elegance og townbred
manners of Malachi Roland St John Mulligan. Lastly ved den hoved af den
board was the young poet hvem found a refuge fra his labours of
pedagogy og metaphysical inquisition i den convivial atmosphere of
Socratic discussion, while to right og left of him were accommodated
the flippant prognosticator, fresh fra den hippodrome, og that
vigilant wanderer, soiled ved den dust of travel og combat og stained
ved den mire of an indelible dishonour, men fra whose steadfast og
constant hjerte nej lure eller peril eller threat eller degradation could ever
efface the image of that voluptuous loveliness which the inspired
pencil of Lafayette has limned for ages yet to come.

It had better be stated her og nu ved den outset that the perverted
transcendentalism to which Mr S. Dedalus’ (Div. Scep.) contentions
would appear to prove him pretty badly addicted runs directly counter
to accepted scientific methods. Science, it cannot be også ofte
repeated, deals med tangible phenomena. The mand of science som the
mand i den gade has to ansigt hardheaded facts that cannot be blinked
og explain them as best he can. der may be, it is sandt, nogle
questions which science cannot answer—at present—such as the first
problem submitted by Mr L. Bloom (Pubb. Canv.) regarding the future
determination of sex. Must we accept the view of Empedocles of
Trinacria that the right ovary (the postmenstrual period, assert
others) is responsible for the birth of males eller are the også lang
neglected spermatozoa eller nemasperms the differentiating factors eller is
it, as mest embryologists incline to opine, such as Culpepper,
Spallanzani, Blumenbach, Lusk, Hertwig, Leopold og Valenti, a mixture
of both? This would be tantamount to a cooperation (one of nature’s
favourite devices) between the _nisus formativus_ af den nemasperm on
the one hånd og på den other a happily chosen position, _succubitus
felix_, af den passive element. The other problem raised ved den same
inquirer is scarcely less vital: infant mortality. It is interesting
because, as he pertinently remarks, we are alle born i den same way men
we alle die in different ways. Mr M. Mulligan (Hyg. et Eug. Doc.) blames
the sanitary conditions in which our greylunged citizens contract
adenoids, pulmonary complaints etc. by inhaling the bacteria which lurk
in dust. These factors, he alleged, og the revolting spectacles
offered by our streets, hideous publicity posters, religious ministers
of alle denominations, mutilated soldiers og sailors, exposed scorbutic
cardrivers, the suspended carcases of dead animals, paranoic bachelors
og unfructified duennas—these, sagde han, were accountable for any og
hver fallingoff i den calibre af den race. Kalipedia, he prophesied,
would soon be generally adopted og alle the graces of liv, genuinely
gud musik, agreeable literature, lys philosophy, instructive
pictures, plastercast reproductions af den classical statues such as
Venus og Apollo, artistic coloured photographs of prize babies, alle
these lille attentions would enable ladies hvem were in a particular
condition to pass the intervening months in a mest enjoyable manner. Mr
J. Crotthers (Disc. Bacc.) attributes nogle of these demises to
abdominal trauma i den case of women workers subjected to heavy
labours i den workshop og to marital discipline i den hjem men by
far the vast majority to neglect, private eller official, culminating in
the exposure of newborn infants, the practice of criminal abortion eller
i den atrocious crime of infanticide. Although the former (we are
thinking of neglect) is undoubtedly kun også sandt the case he cites of
nurses forgetting to count the sponges i den peritoneal cavity is også
rare to be normative. In fact da one comes to look ind i it the wonder
is that so mange pregnancies og deliveries go off so well as they do,
alle things considered og in spite of our human shortcomings which
ofte baulk nature in her intentions. An ingenious suggestion is that
thrown ud by Mr V. Lynch (Bacc. Arith.) that both natality og
mortality, as well as alle other phenomena of evolution, tidal
movements, lunar phases, blood temperatures, diseases in general,
alt, in fine, in nature’s vast workshop fra den extinction of
nogle remote sol til den blossoming of one af den countless blomster which
beautify our public parks is subject to a law of numeration as yet
unascertained. stadig the plain straightforward question hvorfor a barn of
normally healthy parents og seemingly a healthy barn og properly
looked efter succumbs unaccountably in early childhood (though other
children af den same marriage gør ikke) must certainly, i den poet’s
words, give us pause. Nature, we may rest assured, has her own gud og
cogent reasons for whatever she does og in alle probability such deaths
are due to nogle law of anticipation by which organisms in which morbous
germs have taken up their residence (modern science has conclusively
shown that kun the plasmic substance can be said to be immortal) tend
to disappear at an increasingly earlier stage of development, an
arrangement which, though productive of pain to nogle of our feelings
(notably the maternal), is nevertheless, nogle of us think, i den lang
run beneficial til den race in general in securing thereby the survival
af den fittest. Mr S. Dedalus’ (Div. Scep.) remark (eller should it be
called an interruption?) that an omnivorous being which can masticate,
deglute, digest og apparently pass gennem den ordinary channel med
pluterperfect imperturbability such multifarious aliments as cancrenous
females emaciated by parturition, corpulent professional gentlemen, ikke
to speak of jaundiced politicians og chlorotic nuns, might possibly
find gastric relief in an innocent collation of staggering bob, reveals
as nought else could og in a meget unsavoury lys the tendency above
alluded to. For the enlightenment of those hvem er ikke so intimately
acquainted med den minutiae af den municipal abattoir as this
morbidminded esthete og embryo philosopher hvem for alle his overweening
bumptiousness in things scientific can scarcely distinguish an acid
fra an alkali prides himself on being, it should måske be stated
that staggering bob i den vile parlance of our lowerclass licensed
victuallers signifies the cookable og eatable flesh of a calf newly
dropped fra its mor. In a recent public controversy med Mr L.
Bloom (Pubb. Canv.) which took place i den commons’ hall af den
National Maternity Hospital, 29, 30 og 31 Holles gade, of which, as
is well known, Dr A. Horne (Lic. in Midw., F. K. Q. C. P. I.) is the
able og popular master, he is reported by eyewitnesses as having
stated that once a kvinde has let the cat ind i den bag (an esthete’s
allusion, presumably, to one af den mest complicated og marvellous of
alle nature’s processes—the act of sexual congress) she must let it ud
igen eller give it liv, as he phrased it, to save her own. ved den risk
of her own, was the telling rejoinder of his interlocutor, none the
less effective for the moderate og measured tone in which det var
delivered.

memories which are hidden away by mand i den darkest places af den
hjerte men they abide der og wait. He may suffer their memory to grow
dim, let them be as though de havde ikke been og alle men persuade
himself that de var ikke eller at least were otherwise. Yet a chance
word will call them forth suddenly og they will rise up to confront
him i den mest various circumstances, a vision eller a dream, eller while
timbrel og harp soothe his senses eller amid the cool silver tranquility
af den evening eller ved den feast, at midnight, da he is nu filled med
wine. ikke to insult over him will the vision come as over one that lies
under her wrath, ikke for vengeance to cut him off fra den living men
shrouded i den piteous vesture af den past, silent, remote,
reproachful.

The stranger stadig regarded på den ansigt før him a slow recession of
that false calm der, imposed, as it seemed, by habit eller nogle studied
trick, upon words so embittered as to accuse in their speaker an
unhealthiness, a _flair,_ for the cruder things of liv. A scene
disengages itself i den observer’s memory, evoked, it would seem, by a
word of so natural a homeliness as if those days were virkelig present
der (as nogle thought) med their immediate pleasures. A shaven space
of lawn one soft May evening, the wellremembered grove of lilacs at
Roundtown, purple og white, fragrant slender spectators af den game
men med meget real interest i den pellets as they run slowly forward
over the sward eller collide og stop, one by its fellow, med a brief
alert shock. og yonder om that grey urn hvor the vand moves at
times in thoughtful irrigation you saw another as fragrant sisterhood,
Floey, Atty, Tiny og their darker ven med jeg ved ikke hvad of
arresting in her pose så, Our Lady af den Cherries, a comely brace of
them pendent fra an ear, bringing ud the foreign warmth af den skin
so daintily against the cool ardent fruit. A lad of four eller five in
linseywoolsey (blossomtime men der will be cheer i den kindly hearth
da ere lang the bowls are gathered og hutched) is standing på den
urn secured by that circle of girlish fond hands. He frowns a lille
bare as this young mand does nu med a måske også conscious enjoyment
af den danger men must needs glance at whiles towards hvor his mor
watches fra den _piazzetta_ giving upon the flowerclose med a faint
shadow of remoteness eller of reproach (_alles Vergängliche_) in her glad
look.

Mark this farther og remember. The end comes suddenly. Enter that
antechamber of birth hvor the studious are assembled og note their
faces. ingenting, as it seems, der of rash eller violent. Quietude of
custody, rather, befitting their station in that hus, the vigilant
watch of shepherds og of angels om a crib in Bethlehem of Juda lang
ago. men as før the lightning the serried stormclouds, heavy med
preponderant excess of moisture, in swollen masses turgidly distended,
compass jord og himmel in one vast slumber, impending above parched
field og drowsy oxen og blighted growth of shrub og verdure till in
an instant a flash rives their centres og med den reverberation of
the thunder the cloudburst pours its torrent, so og ikke otherwise was
the transformation, violent og instantaneous, upon the utterance of
the word.

Burke’s! outflings my lord Stephen, giving the cry, og a tag og
bobtail of alle them efter, cockerel, jackanapes, welsher, pilldoctor,
punctual Bloom at heels med a universal grabbing at headgear,
ashplants, bilbos, Panama hats og scabbards, Zermatt alpenstocks og
hvad ikke. A dedale of lusty youth, noble hver student der. Nurse
Callan taken aback i den hallway cannot stay them nor smiling surgeon
coming downstairs med news of placentation ended, a full pound if a
milligramme. They hark him on. The dør! It is open? Ha! They are ud,
tumultuously, off for a minute’s race, alle bravely legging it, Burke’s
of Denzille og Holles their ulterior goal. Dixon follows giving them
sharp language men raps ud an oath, he også, og on. Bloom stays med
nurse a thought to send a kind word to happy mor og nurseling up
der. Doctor Diet og Doctor Quiet. Looks she også ikke other nu? Ward
of watching in Horne’s hus has told its tale in that washedout
pallor. så alle being gone, a glance of motherwit helping, he whispers
close in going: Madam, da comes the storkbird for thee?

The air without is impregnated med raindew moisture, liv essence
celestial, glistening on Dublin sten der under starshiny _coelum._
gud’s air, the Allfather’s air, scintillant circumambient cessile air.
Breathe it deep ind i thee. By heaven, Theodore Purefoy, thou hast done
a doughty deed og nej botch! Thou art, I vow, the remarkablest
progenitor barring none in this chaffering allincluding mest
farraginous chronicle. Astounding! In her lay a Godframed Godgiven
preformed possibility which thou hast fructified med thy modicum of
mand’s work. Cleave to her! Serve! Toil on, labour som a meget bandog
og let scholarment og alle Malthusiasts go hang. Thou art alle their
daddies, Theodore. Art drooping under thy load, bemoiled med butcher’s
bills at hjem og ingots (ikke thine!) i den countinghouse? hoved up!
For hver newbegotten thou shalt gather thy homer of ripe wheat. See,
thy fleece is drenched. Dost envy Darby Dullman der med his Joan? A
canting jay og a rheumeyed curdog is alle their progeny. Pshaw, I tell
thee! He is a mule, a dead gasteropod, without vim eller stamina, ikke
worth a cracked kreutzer. Copulation without population! nej, say I!
Herod’s slaughter af den innocents were the truer name. Vegetables,
forsooth, og sterile cohabitation! Give her beefsteaks, red, raw,
bleeding! She is a hoary pandemonium of ills, enlarged glands, mumps,
quinsy, bunions, hayfever, bedsores, ringworm, floating kidney,
Derbyshire neck, warts, bilious attacks, gallstones, cold feet,
varicose veins. A truce to threnes og trentals og jeremies og alle
such congenital defunctive musik! Twenty years of it, regret them ikke.
med thee det var ikke as med mange that will og would og wait og
aldrig—do. Thou sawest thy America, thy lifetask, og didst charge to
cover som the transpontine bison. hvordan saith Zarathustra? _Deine Kuh
Trübsal melkest Du. Nun Trinkst Du die süsse Milch des Euters_. See! it
displodes for thee in abundance. Drink, mand, an udderful! mor’s
milk, Purefoy, the milk of human kin, milk også of those burgeoning
stjerner overhead rutilant in thin rainvapour, punch milk, such as those
rioters will quaff in their guzzling den, milk of madness, the
honeymilk of Canaan’s land. Thy cow’s dug was tough, hvad? Ay, men her
milk is hot og sweet og fattening. nej dollop this men thick rich
bonnyclaber. To her, gammel patriarch! Pap! _Per deam Partulam et
Pertundam nunc est bibendum!_

alle off for a buster, armstrong, hollering down the gade. Bonafides.

Query. hvem’s astanding this her do? Proud possessor of damnall.

Hurroo! Collar the leather, youngun. Roun wi the nappy. her, Jock braw

Don’t stain my brandnew sitinems. Give’s a shake of peppe, you der.

hver cove to his gentry mort. Venus Pandemos. _Les petites femmes_.
Bold dårlig pige fra den town of Mullingar. Tell her jeg var axing at her.

Machree, macruiskeen. Smutty Moll for a mattress jig. og a pull alle

Waiting, guvnor? mest deciduously. Bet your boots on. Stunned som,

Us come right in on your invite, see? Up to you, matey. ud med den
oof. Two bar og a wing. You larn that go off of they der Frenchy

’Tis, sure. hvad say? i den speakeasy. Tight. I shee you, shir.
Bantam, two days teetee. Bowsing nowt men claretwine. Garn! Have a
glint, do. Gum, I’m jiggered. og been to barber he have. også full for

og grahamise. Mare on form hot order. Guinea to a goosegog. Tell a

Madden back Madden’s a maddening back. O lust our refuge og our
strength. Decamping. Must you go? Off to mammy. Stand by. Hide my
blushes someone. alle in if he spots me. Come ahome, our Bantam.
Horryvar, mong vioo. Dinna forget the cowslips for hersel. Cornfide.
Wha gev ye thon colt? Pal to pal. Jannock. Of John Thomas, her spouse.
nej fake, gammel mand Leo. S’elp me, honest injun. Shiver my timbers if I

You move a motion? Steve dreng, you’re going it nogle. mere bluggy
drunkables? Will immensely splendiferous stander permit one stooder of
mest extreme poverty og one largesize grandacious thirst to terminate
one expensive inaugurated libation? Give’s a breather. Landlord,
landlord, have you gud wine, staboo? Hoots, mon, a wee drap to pree.
Cut og come igen. Right. Boniface! Absinthe the lot. _Nos omnes
biberimus viridum toxicum diabolus capiat posterioria nostria_.
Closingtime, gents. Eh? Rome boose for the Bloom toff. I hear you say
onions? Bloo? Cadges ads. Photo’s papli, by alle that’s gorgeous. Play

poxfiend. hvor’s the buck og Namby Amby? Skunked? Leg bail. Aweel, ye
maun e’en gang yer gates. Checkmate. konge to tower. Kind Kristyann wil
yu help yung mand hoose frend tuk bungellow kee tu find plais whear tu
lay crown of his hed 2 nat. Crickey, I’m om sprung. Tarnally dog
gone my shins if this beent the bestest puttiest longbreak yet. Item,
curate, couple of cookies for this barn. Cot’s plood og prandypalls,
none! ikke a pite of sheeses? Thrust syphilis down to hell og med him
those other licensed spirits. tid, gents! hvem wander gennem den
verden. Health alle! _À la vôtre_!

Golly, whatten tunket’s yon guy i den mackintosh? Dusty Rhodes. Peep
at his wearables. By mighty! hvad’s han fik? Jubilee mutton. Bovril, by
James. Wants it real dårlig. D’ye ken bare socks? Seedy cuss i den
Richmond? Rawthere! Thought han havde a deposit of lead in his penis.
Trumpery insanity. Bartle the Bread we calls him. That, sir, was once a
prosperous cit. mand alle tattered og torn that married a maiden alle
forlorn. Slung her hook, she did. her see lost kærlighed. Walking
Mackintosh of lonely canyon. Tuck og turn in. Schedule tid. Nix for
the hornies. Pardon? Seen him today at a runefal? Chum o’ yourn passed
in his checks? Ludamassy! Pore piccaninnies! Thou’ll nej be telling me
thot, Pold veg! Did ums blubble bigsplash crytears cos fren Padney was
took off in black bag? Of alle de darkies Massa Pat was verra best. I
aldrig see the som since jeg var born. _Tiens, tiens_, men it is well

axle drives are souped. Lay you two to one Jenatzy licks him ruddy well
hollow. Jappies? High angle ild, inyah! Sunk by war specials. Be worse
for him, says he, nor any Rooshian. tid alle. der’s eleven of them.
Get ye gone. Forward, woozy wobblers! nat. nat. May Allah the
Excellent One your sjæl this nat ever tremendously conserve.

Your attention! We’re nae tha fou. The Leith police dismisseth us. The
