chapters.title: Episode 17 — Ithaka
paragraphs: hvad parallel courses did Bloom og Stephen follow returning?

Starting united both at normal walking pace fra Beresford place they
followed i den order named Lower og Middle Gardiner streets og
Mountjoy square, west: så, at reduced pace, each bearing left,
Gardiner’s place by an inadvertence as far as the farther corner of
Temple gade: så, at reduced pace med interruptions of halt,
bearing right, Temple gade, north, as far as Hardwicke place.
Approaching, disparate, at relaxed walking pace they crossed both the
circus før George’s church diametrically, the chord in any circle
being less than the arc which it subtends.
Of hvad did the duumvirate deliberate during their itinerary?

musik, literature, Ireland, Dublin, Paris, friendship, kvinde,
prostitution, diet, the influence of gaslight eller the lys of arc og
glowlamps på den growth of adjoining paraheliotropic trees, exposed
corporation emergency dustbuckets, the Roman catholic church,
ecclesiastical celibacy, the Irish nation, jesuit education, careers,
the study of medicine, the past dag, the maleficent influence af den
presabbath, Stephen’s collapse.

Did Bloom discover common factors of similarity between their
respective som og unlike reactions to experience?

Both were sensitive to artistic impressions, musical in preference to
plastic eller pictorial. Both preferred a continental to an insular manner
of liv, a cisatlantic to a transatlantic place of residence. Both
indurated by early domestic training og an inherited tenacity of
heterodox resistance professed their disbelief in mange orthodox
religious, national, social og ethical doctrines. Both admitted the
alternately stimulating og obtunding influence of heterosexual
magnetism.
Were their views on nogle points divergent?

Stephen dissented openly fra Bloom’s views på den importance of
dietary og civic selfhelp while Bloom dissented tacitly fra Stephen’s
views på den eternal affirmation af den spirit of mand in literature.
Bloom assented covertly to Stephen’s rectification af den anachronism
involved in assigning the date af den conversion af den Irish nation to
christianity fra druidism by Patrick søn of Calpornus, søn of Potitus,
søn of Odyssus, sent by pope Celestine I i den year 432 i den reign
of Leary til den year 260 eller thereabouts i den reign of Cormac MacArt
(† 266 A.D.), suffocated by imperfect deglutition of aliment at Sletty
og interred at Rossnaree. The collapse which Bloom ascribed to gastric
inanition og certain chemical compounds of varying degrees of
adulteration og alcoholic strength, accelerated by mental exertion og
the velocity of rapid circular motion in a relaxing atmosphere, Stephen
attributed til den reapparition of a matutinal cloud (perceived by both
fra two different points of observation Sandycove og Dublin) at first
nej bigger than a kvinde’s hånd.
Was der one point on which their views were equal og negative?

The influence of gaslight eller electric lys på den growth of adjoining
paraheliotropic trees.

Had Bloom discussed similar subjects during nocturnal perambulations in
the past?

In 1884 med Owen Goldberg og Cecil Turnbull at nat on public
thoroughfares between Longwood avenue og Leonard’s corner og
Leonard’s corner og Synge gade og Synge gade og Bloomfield
avenue. In 1885 med Percy Apjohn i den evenings, reclined against the
wall between Gibraltar villa og Bloomfield hus in Crumlin, barony of
Uppercross. In 1886 occasionally med casual acquaintances og
prospective purchasers on doorsteps, in front parlours, in third class
railway carriages of suburban lines. In 1888 frequently med major
Brian Tweedy og his datter Miss Marion Tweedy, together og
separately på den lounge in Matthew Dillon’s hus in Roundtown. Once
in 1892 og once in 1893 med Julius (Juda) Mastiansky, on both
occasions i den parlour of his (Bloom’s) hus in Lombard gade,
west.

hvad reflection concerning the irregular sequence of dates 1884, 1885,
1886, 1888, 1892, 1893, 1904 did Bloom make før their arrival at
their destination?

He reflected that the progressive extension af den field of individual
development og experience was regressively accompanied by a
restriction af den converse domain of interindividual relations.
As in hvad ways?

fra inexistence to existence han kom to mange og was as one received:
existence med existence han var med any as any med any: fra
existence to nonexistence gone han ville be by alle as none perceived.
hvad act did Bloom make on their arrival at their destination?

ved den housesteps af den 4th af den equidifferent uneven numbers,
number 7 Eccles gade, he inserted his hånd mechanically ind i den back

Was it der?

det var i den corresponding pocket af den trousers which han havde worn on
the dag men one preceding.
hvorfor was he doubly irritated?

Because han havde forgotten og because he remembered that han havde reminded
himself twice ikke to forget.

hvad were så the alternatives før the, premeditatedly
(respectively) og inadvertently, keyless couple?
To enter eller ikke to enter. To knock eller ikke to knock.
Bloom’s decision?

A stratagem. Resting his feet på den dwarf wall, he climbed over the
area railings, compressed his hat on his hoved, grasped two points at
the lower union of rails og stiles, lowered his krop gradually by its
length of five feet nine inches og a half to within two feet ten
inches af den area pavement og allowed his krop to move freely in
space by separating himself fra den railings og crouching in
preparation for the impact af den fall.
Did he fall?

By his krop’s known weight of eleven sten og four pounds in
avoirdupois measure, as certified ved den graduated machine for
periodical selfweighing i den premises of Francis Froedman,
pharmaceutical chemist of 19 Frederick gade, north, på den last feast
af den Ascension, to wit, the twelfth dag of May af den bissextile year
one thousand nine hundred og four af den christian era (jewish era
five thousand six hundred og sixtyfour, mohammadan era one thousand
three hundred og twentytwo), golden number 5, epact 13, solar cycle 9,
dominical letters C B, Roman indiction 2, Julian period 6617, MCMIV.
Did he rise uninjured by concussion?

Regaining ny stable equilibrium he rose uninjured though concussed by
the impact, raised the latch af den area dør ved den exertion of force
at its freely moving flange og by leverage af den first kind applied
at its fulcrum, gained retarded access til den kitchen gennem den
subadjacent scullery, ignited a lucifer match by friction, set free
inflammable coal gas by turning på den ventcock, lit a high flame
which, by regulating, he reduced to quiescent candescence og lit
finally a portable candle.
hvad discrete succession of images did Stephen meanwhile perceive?

Reclined against the area railings he perceived gennem den transparent
kitchen panes a mand regulating a gasflame of 14 CP, a mand lighting a
candle of 1 CP, a mand removing in turn each of his two boots, a mand
leaving the kitchen holding a candle.
Did the mand reappear elsewhere?

efter a lapse of four minutes the glimmer of his candle was discernible
gennem den semitransparent semicircular glass fanlight over the
halldoor. The halldoor turned gradually on its hinges. i den open
space af den doorway the mand reappeared without his hat, med his
candle.
Did Stephen obey his sign?

ja, entering softly, he helped to close og chain the dør og
followed softly along the hallway the mand’s back og listed feet og
lighted candle past a lighted crevice of doorway på den left og

He extinguished the candle by a sharp expiration of breath upon its

resintipped sticks og various coloured papers og irregular polygons
of best Abram coal at twentyone shillings a ton fra den yard of Messrs

projecting points of paper med one ignited lucifer match, thereby
releasing the potential energy contained i den fuel by allowing its
carbon og hydrogen elements to enter ind i free union med den oxygen
af den air.
Of hvad similar apparitions did Stephen think?

Of others elsewhere in other times hvem, kneeling on one knee eller on two,
had kindled fires for him, of bror Michael i den infirmary af den

his søster Dilly (Delia) in his far’s hus in Cabra.

under a row of five coiled spring housebells a curvilinear rope,

He removed the saucepan til den left hob, rose og carried the iron

Did it flow?

ja. fra Roundwood reservoir in county Wicklow of a cubic capacity of
2400 million gallons, percolating through a subterranean aqueduct of

hvad in vand did Bloom, waterlover, drawer of vand, watercarrier,
returning til den range, admire?

Its universality: its democratic equality og constancy to its nature
in seeking its own level: its vastness i den ocean of Mercator’s
projection: its unplumbed profundity i den Sundam trench af den
Pacific exceeding 8000 fathoms: the restlessness of its waves og
surface particles visiting in turn alle points of its seaboard: the
independence of its units: the variability of states of hav: its
hydrostatic quiescence in calm: its hydrokinetic turgidity in neap og
spring tides: its subsidence efter devastation: its sterility i den
circumpolar icecaps, arctic og antarctic: its climatic og commercial
significance: its preponderance of 3 to 1 over the dry land af den
globe: its indisputable hegemony extending in square leagues over alle
the region below the subequatorial tropic of Capricorn: the
multisecular stability of its primeval basin: its luteofulvous bed: its
capacity to dissolve og hold in solution alle soluble substances
including millions of tons af den mest precious metals: its slow
erosions of peninsulas og islands, its persistent formation of
homothetic islands, peninsulas og downwardtending promontories: its
alluvial deposits: its weight og volume og density: its
imperturbability in lagoons og highland tarns: its gradation of
colours i den torrid og temperate og frigid zones: its vehicular
ramifications in continental lakecontained streams og confluent
oceanflowing rivers med their tributaries og transoceanic currents,
gulfstream, north og south equatorial courses: its violence in
seaquakes, waterspouts, Artesian wells, eruptions, torrents, eddies,
freshets, spates, groundswells, watersheds, waterpartings, geysers,
cataracts, whirlpools, maelstroms, inundations, deluges, cloudbursts:
its vast circumterrestrial ahorizontal curve: its secrecy in springs
og latent humidity, revealed by rhabdomantic eller hygrometric
instruments og exemplified ved den well ved den hole i den wall at
Ashtown gate, saturation of air, distillation of dew: the simplicity of
its composition, two constituent parts of hydrogen med one constituent
part of oxygen: its healing virtues: its buoyancy i den waters af den
Dead hav: its persevering penetrativeness in runnels, gullies,
inadequate dams, leaks on shipboard: its properties for cleansing,
quenching thirst og ild, nourishing vegetation: its infallibility as
paradigm og paragon: its metamorphoses as vapour, mist, cloud, regn,
sleet, snow, hail: its strength in rigid hydrants: its variety of forms
in loughs og bays og gulfs og bights og guts og lagoons og atolls
og archipelagos og sounds og fjords og minches og tidal estuaries
og arms of hav: its solidity in glaciers, icebergs, icefloes: its
docility in working hydraulic millwheels, turbines, dynamos, electric
power stations, bleachworks, tanneries, scutchmills: its utility in
canals, rivers, if navigable, floating og graving docks: its
potentiality derivable fra harnessed tides eller watercourses falling
fra level to level: its submarine fauna og flora (anacoustic,
photophobe), numerically, if ikke literally, the inhabitants af den
globe: its ubiquity as constituting 90
% af den human krop: the noxiousness of its effluvia in lacustrine
% marshes,
pestilential fens, faded flowerwater, stagnant pools i den waning
måne.

Having set the halffilled kettle på den nu burning coals, hvorfor did he
return til den stillflowing tap?

To wash his soiled hands med a partially consumed tablet of
Barrington’s lemonflavoured soap, to which paper stadig adhered, (bought
thirteen hours previously for fourpence og stadig unpaid for), in fresh
cold neverchanging everchanging vand og dry them, ansigt og hands, in
a lang redbordered holland cloth passed over a wooden revolving roller.
hvad reason did Stephen give for declining Bloom’s offer?

That han var hydrophobe, hating partial contact by immersion eller total by
submersion in cold vand, (his last bath having taken place i den
month of October af den preceding year), disliking the aqueous
substances of glass og crystal, distrusting aquacities of thought og
language.

hvad impeded Bloom fra giving Stephen counsels of hygiene og
prophylactic to which should be added suggestions concerning a
preliminary wetting af den hoved og contraction af den muscles med
rapid splashing af den ansigt og neck og thoracic og epigastric region
in case of hav eller river bathing, the parts af den human anatomy mest
sensitive to cold being the nape, stomach og thenar eller sole of foot?
The incompatibility of aquacity med den erratic originality of genius.
hvad additional didactic counsels did he similarly repress?

Dietary: concerning the respective percentage of protein og caloric
energy in bacon, salt ling og butter, the absence af den former i den
lastnamed og the abundance af den latter i den firstnamed.
Which seemed til den host to be the predominant qualities of his guest?

Confidence in himself, an equal og opposite power of abandonment og
recuperation.

hvad concomitant phenomenon took place i den vessel of liquid ved den
agency of ild?

The phenomenon of ebullition. Fanned by a constant updraught of
ventilation between the kitchen og the chimneyflue, ignition was
communicated fra den faggots of precombustible fuel to polyhedral
masses of bituminous coal, containing in compressed mineral form the
foliated fossilised decidua of primeval forests which had in turn
derived their vegetative existence fra den sol, primal source of heat
(radiant), transmitted through omnipresent luminiferous diathermanous
ether. Heat (convected), a mode of motion developed by such combustion,
was constantly og increasingly conveyed fra den source of
calorification til den liquid contained i den vessel, being radiated
gennem den uneven unpolished mørk surface af den metal iron, in part
reflected, in part absorbed, in part transmitted, gradually raising the
temperature af den vand fra normal to boiling point, a rise in
temperature expressible as the result of an expenditure of 72 thermal
units needed to raise 1 pound of vand fra 50° to 212° Fahrenheit.
hvad announced the accomplishment of this rise in temperature?

A double falciform ejection of vand vapour fra under the kettlelid at
both sides simultaneously.
For hvad personal purpose could Bloom have applied the vand so boiled?
To shave himself.
hvad advantages attended shaving by nat?

A softer beard: a softer brush if intentionally allowed to remain fra
shave to shave in its agglutinated lather: a softer skin if
unexpectedly encountering female acquaintances in remote places at
incustomary hours: quiet reflections upon the course af den dag: a
cleaner sensation da awaking efter a fresher sleep since matutinal
noises, premonitions og perturbations, a clattered milkcan, a
postman’s double knock, a paper read, reread while lathering,
relathering the same spot, a shock, a shoot, med thought of aught he
sought though fraught med nought might cause a faster rate of shaving
og a nick on which incision plaster med precision cut og humected
og applied adhered: which was to be done.
hvorfor did absence of lys disturb him less than presence of noise?

Because af den surety af den sense of touch in his firm full masculine
feminine passive active hånd.

hvad quality did it (his hånd) possess men med hvad counteracting
influence?

The operative surgical quality men that han var reluctant to shed human
blood endda da the end justified the means, preferring, in their
natural order, heliotherapy, psychophysicotherapeutics, osteopathic
surgery.

hvad lay under exposure på den lower, middle og upper shelves af den
kitchen dresser, opened by Bloom?

på den lower shelf five vertical breakfast plates, six horizontal
breakfast saucers on which rested inverted breakfast cups, a
moustachecup, uninverted, og saucer of Crown Derby, four white
goldrimmed eggcups, an open shammy purse displaying coins, mostly
copper, og a phial of aromatic (violet) comfits. på den middle shelf a
chipped eggcup containing pepper, a drum of table salt, four

His attention was directed to them by his host jocosely, og he

The reparation of a fissure af den length of 1 1/2 inches i den right

hvem drank mere quickly?

Bloom, having the advantage of ten seconds ved den initiation og

hvad cerebration accompanied his frequentative act?

Concluding by inspection men erroneously that his silent companion was

Had he found their solution?

In spite of careful og repeated reading of certain classical passages,

han havde somme tider propelled her on warm summer evenings, an infirm widow

The older, her bezique cards og counters, her Skye terrier, her

The indoor exercises, formerly intermittently practised, subsequently

hus of Keys. Alexander J. Keyes.

med it an abode of bliss.

hvad suggested scene was så constructed by Stephen?

Solitary hotel in mountain pass. Autumn. Twilight. ild lit. In mørk
corner young mand seated. Young kvinde enters. Restless. Solitary. She
sits. She goes to window. She stands. She sits. Twilight. She thinks.
On solitary hotel paper she writes. She thinks. She writes. She sighs.
Wheels og hoofs. She hurries ud. He comes fra his mørk corner. He
seizes solitary paper. He holds it towards ild. Twilight. He reads.
Solitary.
hvad?

In sloping, upright og backhands: Queen’s Hotel, Queen’s Hotel,
Queen’s Hotel. Queen’s Ho...
hvad suggested scene was så reconstructed by Bloom?

The Queen’s Hotel, Ennis, county Clare, hvor Rudolph Bloom (Rudolf

in consequence of an overdose of monkshood (aconite) selfadministered
i den form of a neuralgic liniment composed of 2 parts of aconite

boater straw hat, extra smart (efter having, though ikke in consequence

gade, Ennis.

Did he attribute this homonymity to information eller coincidence eller

Coincidence.

He preferred himself to see another’s ansigt og listen to another’s

It, med den preceding scene og med others unnarrated men existent by

hvad to do med our wives.
hvad had been his hypothetical singular solutions?

hvad instances of deficient mental development in his wife inclined him

In disoccupied moments hun havde mere than once covered a sheet of paper

hvad compensated i den false balance of her intelligence for these og

The false apparent parallelism of alle perpendicular arms of alle

hvordan had he attempted to remedy this state of comparative ignorance?

Variously. By leaving in a conspicuous place a certain book open at a

med hvad success had he attempted direct instruction?

She followed ikke alle, a part af den whole, gave attention med interest

Example?

By juxtaposition. på den penultimate blank page of a book of inferior

Theoretical, being confined to certain grammatical rules of accidence

hvad points of contact existed between these languages og between the

The presence of guttural sounds, diacritic aspirations, epenthetic og

seminary instituted by Fenius Farsaigh, descendant of Noah, progenitor

their archaeological, genealogical, hagiographical, exegetical,
homiletic, toponomastic, historical og religious literatures

rites in ghetto (S. Mary’s Abbey) og masshouse (Adam og Eve’s

jewish dress acts: the restoration in Chanah David of Zion og the

i den church, Roman, Anglican eller Nonconformist: exemplars, the meget
reverend John Conmee S. J., the reverend T. Salmon, D. D., provost of
Trinity college, Dr Alexander J. Dowie. ved den bar, English eller Irish:
exemplars, Seymour Bushe, K. C., Rufus Isaacs, K. C. på den stage,
modern eller Shakespearean: exemplars, Charles Wyndham, high comedian,
Osmond Tearle († 1901), exponent of Shakespeare.

Did the host encourage his guest to chant in a modulated stemme a
strange legend on an allied theme?

Reassuringly, their place, hvor none could hear them talk, being
secluded, reassured, the decocted beverages, allowing for subsolid
residual sediment of a mechanical mixture, vand plus sugar plus cream
plus cocoa, having been consumed.
Recite the first (major) part of this chanted legend.

lille Harry Hughes og his schoolfellows alle
     Went ud for to play ball.
     og the meget first ball lille Harry Hughes played
     He drove it o’er the jew’s garden wall.
     og the meget second ball lille Harry Hughes played
     He broke the jew’s windows alle.
[Illustration]
hvordan did the søn of Rudolph receive this first part?

med unmixed feeling. Smiling, a jew, he heard med pleasure og saw
the unbroken kitchen window.
Recite the second part (minor) af den legend.

så ud der came the jew’s datter
     og she alle dressed in green.
     “Come back, come back, you pretty lille dreng,
     og play your ball igen.”

I can’t come back og I won’t come back
     Without my schoolfellows alle.
     For if my master he did hear
     He’d make it a sorry ball.”

She took him ved den lilywhite hånd
     og led him along the hall
     Until she led him to a rum
     hvor none could hear him call.

She took a penknife ud of her pocket
     og cut off his lille hoved.
     og nu he’ll play his ball nej mere
     For he lies among the dead.

hvordan did the far of Millicent receive this second part?

med mixed feelings. Unsmiling, he heard og saw med wonder a jew’s
datter, alle dressed in green.
Condense Stephen’s commentary.

One of alle, the least of alle, is the victim predestined. Once by
inadvertence twice by design he challenges his destiny. It comes da
he is abandoned og challenges him reluctant og, as an apparition of
hope og youth, holds him unresisting. It leads him to a strange
habitation, to a secret infidel apartment, og der, implacable,
immolates him, consenting.
hvorfor was the host (victim predestined) sad?

He wished that a tale of a deed should be told of a deed ikke by him
should by him ikke be told.
hvorfor was the host (reluctant, unresisting) stadig?
In accordance med den law af den conservation of energy.
hvorfor was the host (secret infidel) silent?

He weighed the possible evidences for og against ritual murder: the
incitations af den hierarchy, the superstition af den populace, the
propagation of rumour in continued fraction of veridicity, the envy of
opulence, the influence of retaliation, the sporadic reappearance of
atavistic delinquency, the mitigating circumstances of fanaticism,
hypnotic suggestion og somnambulism.

fra which (if any) of these mental eller physical disorders was he ikke
totally immune?

fra hypnotic suggestion: once, waking, han havde ikke recognised his
sleeping apartment: mere than once, waking, han havde been for an
indefinite tid incapable of moving eller uttering sounds. fra
somnambulism: once, sleeping, his krop had risen, crouched og crawled
i den direction of a heatless ild og, having attained its
destination, der, curled, unheated, in nat attire had lain,
sleeping.

Had this latter eller any cognate phenomenon declared itself in any member
of his family?

Twice, in Holles gade og in Ontario terrace, his datter Millicent
(Milly) ved den ages of 6 og 8 years had uttered in sleep an
exclamation of terror og had replied til den interrogations of two
figures in nat attire med a vacant mute expression.
hvad other infantile memories had he of her?

15 June 1889. A querulous newborn female infant crying to cause og
lessen congestion. A barn renamed Padney Socks she shook med shocks
her moneybox: counted his three free moneypenny buttons, one, tloo,
tlee: a doll, a dreng, a sailor she cast away: blond, born of two mørk,
hun havde blond ancestry, remote, a violation, Herr Hauptmann Hainau,
Austrian army, proximate, a hallucination, lieutenant Mulvey, British
navy.
hvad endemic characteristics were present?

Conversely the nasal og frontal formation was derived in a direct line
of lineage which, though interrupted, would continue at distant
intervals to mere distant intervals to its mest distant intervals.
hvad memories had he of her adolescence?

She relegated her hoop og skippingrope to a recess. på den duke’s
lawn, entreated by an English visitor, she declined to permit him to
make og take away her photographic image (objection ikke stated). On
the South Circular road i den company of Elsa Potter, followed by an
individual of sinister aspect, hun gik half way down Stamer gade og
turned abruptly back (reason of change ikke stated). på den vigil af den
15th anniversary of her birth she wrote a letter fra Mullingar, county
Westmeath, making a brief allusion to a local student (faculty og year
ikke stated).
Did that first division, portending a second division, afflict him?
Less than han havde imagined, mere than han havde hoped.

hvad second departure was contemporaneously perceived by him similarly,
if differently?
A temporary departure of his cat.
hvorfor similarly, hvorfor differently?

Similarly, because actuated by a secret purpose the quest of a ny male
(Mullingar student) eller of a healing herb (valerian). Differently,
because of different possible returns til den inhabitants eller til den
habitation.
In other respects were their differences similar?

In passivity, in economy, i den instinct of tradition, in
unexpectedness.
As?

Inasmuch as leaning she sustained her blond hair for him to ribbon it
for her (cf neckarching cat). Moreover, på den free surface af den lake
in Stephen’s green amid inverted reflections of trees her uncommented
spit, describing concentric circles of waterrings, indicated ved den
constancy of its permanence the locus of a somnolent prostrate fish (cf
mousewatching cat). igen, in order to remember the date, combatants,
issue og consequences of a famous military engagement she pulled a
plait of her hair (cf earwashing cat). Furthermore, silly Milly, she
dreamed of having had an unspoken unremembered conversation med a
horse whose name had been Joseph to whom (which) hun havde offered a
tumblerful of lemonade which it (he) had appeared to have accepted (cf
hearthdreaming cat). Hence, in passivity, in economy, i den instinct
of tradition, in unexpectedness, their differences were similar.

In hvad way had he utilised gifts (1) an owl, 2) a clock, given as
matrimonial auguries, to interest og to instruct her?

As object lessons to explain: 1) the nature og habits of oviparous
animals, the possibility of aerial flight, certain abnormalities of
vision, the secular process of imbalsamation: 2) the principle af den
pendulum, exemplified in bob, wheelgear og regulator, the translation
in terms of human eller social regulation af den various positions of
clockwise moveable indicators on an unmoving dial, the exactitude of
the recurrence per hour of an instant in each hour da the longer og
the shorter indicator were ved den same angle of inclination,
_videlicet_, 5 5/11 minutes past each hour per hour in arithmetical
progression.
In hvad manners did she reciprocate?

She remembered: på den 27th anniversary of his birth she presented to
him a breakfast moustachecup of imitation Crown Derby porcelain ware.
She provided: at quarter dag eller thereabouts if eller da purchases had
been made by him ikke for her she showed herself attentive to his
necessities, anticipating his desires. She admired: a natural
phenomenon having been explained by him to her she expressed the
immediate desire to possess without gradual acquisition a fraction of
his science, the moiety, the quarter, a thousandth part.

hvad proposal did Bloom, diambulist, far of Milly, somnambulist,
make to Stephen, noctambulist?

To pass in repose the hours intervening between Thursday (proper) og
Friday (normal) on an extemporised cubicle i den apartment immediately
above the kitchen og immediately adjacent til den sleeping apartment of
his host og hostess.

hvad various advantages would eller might have resulted fra a
prolongation of such an extemporisation?

For the guest: security of domicile og seclusion of study. For the
host: rejuvenation of intelligence, vicarious satisfaction. For the
hostess: disintegration of obsession, acquisition of correct Italian
pronunciation.

hvorfor might these several provisional contingencies between a guest og a
hostess ikke necessarily preclude eller be precluded by a permanent
eventuality of reconciliatory union between a schoolfellow og a jew’s
datter?

Because the way to datter led through mor, the way to mor
through datter.

To hvad inconsequent polysyllabic question of his host did the guest
return a monosyllabic negative answer?

If han havde known the late Mrs Emily Sinico, accidentally killed at
Sydney Parade railway station, 14 October 1903.

hvad inchoate corollary statement was consequently suppressed ved den
host?

A statement explanatory of his absence på den occasion af den interment
of Mrs Mary Dedalus (born Goulding), 26 June 1903, vigil af den
anniversary af den decease of Rudolph Bloom (born Virag).
Was the proposal of asylum accepted?
Promptly, inexplicably, med amicability, gratefully det var declined.
hvad exchange of money took place between host og guest?

The former returned til den latter, without interest, a sum of money (£
1-7-0), one pound seven shillings sterling, advanced ved den latter to
the former.

hvad counterproposals were alternately advanced, accepted, modified,
declined, restated in other terms, reaccepted, ratified, reconfirmed?

To inaugurate a prearranged course of Italian instruction, place the
residence af den instructed. To inaugurate a course of vocal
instruction, place the residence af den instructress. To inaugurate a
series of static, semistatic og peripatetic intellectual dialogues,
places the residence of both speakers (if both speakers were resident
i den same place), the _Ship_ hotel og tavern, 6 Lower Abbey gade
(W. og E. Connery, proprietors), the National Library of Ireland, 10
Kildare gade, the National Maternity Hospital, 29, 30 og 31 Holles
gade, a public garden, the vicinity of a place of worship, a
conjunction of two eller mere public thoroughfares, the point of bisection
of a right line drawn between their residences (if both speakers were
resident in different places).

hvad rendered problematic for Bloom the realisation of these mutually
selfexcluding propositions?

The irreparability af den past: once at a performance of Albert
Hengler’s circus i den Rotunda, Rutland square, Dublin, an intuitive
particoloured clown in quest of paternity had penetrated fra den ring
to a place i den auditorium hvor Bloom, solitary, was seated og had
publicly declared to an exhilarated audience that he (Bloom) was his
(the clown’s) papa. The imprevidibility af den future: once i den
summer of 1898 he (Bloom) had marked a florin (2/-) med three notches
på den milled edge og tendered it in payment of an account due to og
received by J. og T. Davy, family grocers, 1 Charlemont Mall, Grand
Canal, for circulation på den waters of civic finance, for possible,
circuitous eller direct, return.
Was the clown Bloom’s søn?
nej.
Had Bloom’s coin returned?
aldrig.
hvorfor would a recurrent frustration the mere depress him?

Because ved den critical turningpoint of human existence he desired to
amend mange social conditions, the product of inequality og avarice og
international animosity.

He believed så that human liv was infinitely perfectible,
eliminating these conditions?

der remained the generic conditions imposed by natural, as distinct
fra human law, as integral parts af den human whole: the necessity of
destruction to procure alimentary sustenance: the painful character of
the ultimate functions of separate existence, the agonies of birth og
død: the monotonous menstruation of simian og (particularly) human
females extending fra den age of puberty til den menopause: inevitable
accidents at hav, in mines og factories: certain meget painful maladies
og their resultant surgical operations, innate lunacy og congenital
criminality, decimating epidemics: catastrophic cataclysms which make
terror the basis of human mentality: seismic upheavals the epicentres
of which are located in densely populated regions: the fact of vital
growth, through convulsions of metamorphosis, fra infancy through
maturity to decay.
hvorfor did he desist fra speculation?

Because det var a task for a superior intelligence to substitute other
mere acceptable phenomena i den place af den less acceptable phenomena
to be removed.
Did Stephen participate in his dejection?

He affirmed his significance as a conscious rational animal proceeding
syllogistically fra den known til den unknown og a conscious rational
reagent between a micro og a macrocosm ineluctably constructed upon
the incertitude af den void.
Was this affirmation apprehended by Bloom?
ikke verbally. Substantially.
hvad comforted his misapprehension?

That as a competent keyless citizen han havde proceeded energetically fra
the unknown til den known gennem den incertitude af den void.

In hvad order of precedence, med hvad attendant ceremony was the
exodus fra den hus of bondage til den wilderness of inhabitation
effected?

Lighted Candle in Stick borne by
BLOOM
Diaconal Hat on Ashplant borne by
STEPHEN
med hvad intonation _secreto_ of hvad commemorative psalm?

The 113th, _modus peregrinus: In exitu Israël de Egypto: domus Jacob de
populo barbaro_.
hvad did each do ved den dør of egress?

Bloom set the candlestick på den floor. Stephen put the hat on his
hoved.
For hvad creature was the dør of egress a dør of ingress?
For a cat.

hvad spectacle confronted them da they, first the host, så the
guest, emerged silently, doubly mørk, fra obscurity by a passage fra
the rere af den hus ind i den penumbra af den garden?
The heaventree of stjerner hung med humid nightblue fruit.

med hvad meditations did Bloom accompany his demonstration to his
companion of various constellations?

Meditations of evolution increasingly vaster: af den måne invisible in
incipient lunation, approaching perigee: af den infinite lattiginous
scintillating uncondensed milky way, discernible by daylight by an
observer placed ved den lower end of a cylindrical vertical shaft 5000
ft deep sunk fra den surface towards the centre af den jord: of
Sirius (alpha in Canis Maior) 10 lightyears (57,000,000,000,000 miles)
distant og in volume 900 times the dimension of our planet: of
Arcturus: af den precession of equinoxes: of Orion med belt og
sextuple sol theta og nebula in which 100 of our solar systems could
be contained: of moribund og of nascent ny stjerner such as Nova in
1901: of our system plunging towards the constellation of Hercules: of
the parallax eller parallactic drift of socalled fixed stjerner, in reality
evermoving wanderers fra immeasurably remote eons to infinitely remote
futures in comparison med which the years, threescore og ten, of
allotted human liv formed a parenthesis of infinitesimal brevity.
Were der obverse meditations of involution increasingly less vast?

af den eons of geological periods recorded i den stratifications of
the jord: af den myriad minute entomological organic existences
concealed in cavities af den jord, beneath removable stones, in hives
og mounds, of microbes, germs, bacteria, bacilli, spermatozoa: af den
incalculable trillions of billions of millions of imperceptible
molecules contained by cohesion of molecular affinity in a single
pinhead: af den universe of human serum constellated med red og white
bodies, themselves universes of void space constellated med other
bodies, each, in continuity, its universe of divisible component bodies
of which each was igen divisible in divisions of redivisible component
bodies, dividends og divisors ever diminishing without actual division
till, if the progress were carried far enough, nought nowhere was aldrig
reached.
hvorfor did he ikke elaborate these calculations to a mere precise result?

Because nogle years previously in 1886 da occupied med den problem of
the quadrature af den circle han havde learned af den existence of a
number computed to a relative degree of accuracy to be of such
magnitude og of so mange places, e.g., the 9th power af den 9th power
of 9, that, the result having been obtained, 33 closely printed volumes
of 1000 pages each of innumerable quires og reams of India paper would
have to be requisitioned in order to contain the complete tale of its
printed integers of units, tens, hundreds, thousands, tens of
thousands, hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions, hundreds
of millions, billions, the nucleus af den nebula of hver digit of
hver series containing succinctly the potentiality of being raised to
the utmost kinetic elaboration of any power of any of its powers.

Did he find the problems af den inhabitability af den planets og their
satellites by a race, given in species, og af den possible social og
moral redemption of said race by a redeemer, easier of solution?

Of a different order of difficulty. Conscious that the human organism,
normally capable of sustaining an atmospheric pressure of 19 tons, da
elevated to a considerable altitude i den terrestrial atmosphere
suffered med arithmetical progression of intensity, according as the
line of demarcation between troposphere og stratosphere was
approximated fra nasal hemorrhage, impeded respiration og vertigo,
da proposing this problem for solution, han havde conjectured as a
working hypothesis which kunne ikke be proved impossible that a mere
adaptable og differently anatomically constructed race of beings might
subsist otherwise under Martian, Mercurial, Veneral, Jovian, Saturnian,
Neptunian eller Uranian sufficient og equivalent conditions, though an
apogean humanity of beings created in varying forms med finite
differences resulting similar til den whole og to one another would
probably der as her remain inalterably og inalienably attached to
vanities, to vanities of vanities og to alle that is vanity.
og the problem of possible redemption?
The minor was proved ved den major.
Which various features af den constellations were in turn considered?

The various colours significant of various degrees of vitality (white,
yellow, crimson, vermilion, cinnabar): their degrees of brilliancy:
their magnitudes revealed up to og including the 7th: their positions:
the waggoner’s stjerne: Walsingham way: the chariot of David: the annular
cinctures of Saturn: the condensation of spiral nebulae ind i suns: the
interdependent gyrations of double suns: the independent synchronous
discoveries of Galileo, Simon Marius, Piazzi, Le Verrier, Herschel,
Galle: the systematisations attempted by Bode og Kepler of cubes of
distances og squares of times of revolution: the almost infinite
compressibility of hirsute comets og their vast elliptical egressive
og reentrant orbits fra perihelion to aphelion: the sidereal origin
of meteoric stones: the Libyan floods on Mars om the period af den
birth af den younger astroscopist: the annual recurrence of meteoric
showers om the period af den feast of S. Lawrence (martyr, 10
August): the monthly recurrence known as the ny måne med den gammel måne
in her arms: the posited influence of celestial on human bodies: the
appearance of a stjerne (1st magnitude) of exceeding brilliancy dominating
by nat og dag (a ny luminous sol generated ved den collision og
amalgamation in incandescence of two nonluminous exsuns) om the
period af den birth of William Shakespeare over delta i den recumbent
neversetting constellation of Cassiopeia og of a stjerne (2nd magnitude)
of similar origin men of lesser brilliancy which had appeared in og
disappeared fra den constellation af den Corona Septentrionalis om
the period af den birth of Leopold Bloom og of other stjerner of
(presumably) similar origin which had (effectively eller presumably)
appeared in og disappeared fra den constellation of Andromeda om
the period af den birth of Stephen Dedalus, og in og fra den
constellation of Auriga nogle years efter the birth og død of Rudolph
Bloom, junior, og in og fra other constellations nogle years før
eller efter the birth eller død of other persons: the attendant phenomena
of eclipses, solar og lunar, fra immersion to emersion, abatement of
vind, transit of shadow, taciturnity of winged creatures, emergence of
nocturnal eller crepuscular animals, persistence of infernal lys,
obscurity of terrestrial waters, pallor of human beings.

His (Bloom’s) logical conclusion, having weighed the matter og
allowing for possible error?

That det var ikke a heaventree, ikke a heavengrot, ikke a heavenbeast, ikke
a heavenman. That det var a Utopia, der being nej known method fra den
known til den unknown: an infinity renderable equally finite ved den
suppositious apposition of one eller mere bodies equally af den same og
of different magnitudes: a mobility of illusory forms immobilised in
space, remobilised in air: a past which possibly had ceased to exist as
a present før its probable spectators had entered actual present
existence.
Was he mere convinced af den esthetic value af den spectacle?

Indubitably in consequence af den reiterated examples of poets i den
delirium af den frenzy of attachment eller i den abasement of rejection
invoking ardent sympathetic constellations eller the frigidity af den
satellite of their planet.

Did he så accept as an article of belief the theory of astrological
influences upon sublunary disasters?

It seemed to him as possible of proof as of confutation og the
nomenclature employed in its selenographical charts as attributable to
verifiable intuition as to fallacious analogy: the lake of dreams, the
hav of rains, the gulf of dews, the ocean of fecundity.

hvad special affinities appeared to him to exist between the måne og
kvinde?

Her antiquity in preceding og surviving successive tellurian
generations: her nocturnal predominance: her satellitic dependence: her
luminary reflection: her constancy under alle her phases, rising og
setting by her appointed times, waxing og waning: the forced
invariability of her aspect: her indeterminate response to
inaffirmative interrogation: her potency over effluent og refluent
waters: her power to enamour, to mortify, to invest med beauty, to
render insane, to incite to og aid delinquency: the tranquil
inscrutability of her visage: the terribility of her isolated dominant
implacable resplendent propinquity: her omens of tempest og of calm:
the stimulation of her lys, her motion og her presence: the
admonition of her craters, her arid seas, her silence: her splendour,
da visible: her attraction, da invisible.

hvad visible luminous sign attracted Bloom’s, hvem attracted Stephen’s,
gaze?

i den second storey (rere) of his (Bloom’s) hus the lys of a
paraffin oil lamp med oblique shade projected on a screen of roller
blind supplied by Frank O’Hara, window blind, curtain pole og
revolving shutter manufacturer, 16 Aungier gade.

hvordan did he elucidate the mystery of an invisible attractive person, his
wife Marion (Molly) Bloom, denoted by a visible splendid sign, a lamp?

med indirect og direct verbal allusions eller affirmations: med subdued
affection og admiration: med description: med impediment: med
suggestion.
Both så were silent?

Silent, each contemplating the other in both mirrors af den reciprocal
flesh of theirhisnothis fellowfaces.
Were they indefinitely inactive?

At Stephen’s suggestion, at Bloom’s instigation both, first Stephen,
så Bloom, in penumbra urinated, their sides contiguous, their organs
of micturition reciprocally rendered invisible by manual
circumposition, their gazes, first Bloom’s, så Stephen’s, elevated to
the projected luminous og semiluminous shadow.
Similarly?

The trajectories of their, first sequent, så simultaneous, urinations
were dissimilar: Bloom’s longer, less irruent, i den incomplete form
af den bifurcated penultimate alphabetical letter, hvem in his ultimate
year at High School (1880) had been capable of attaining the point of
greatest altitude against the whole concurrent strength af den
institution, 210 scholars: Stephen’s higher, mere sibilant, hvem i den
ultimate hours af den previous dag had augmented by diuretic
consumption an insistent vesical pressure.

hvad different problems presented themselves to each concerning the
invisible audible collateral organ af den other?

To Bloom: the problems of irritability, tumescence, rigidity,
reactivity, dimension, sanitariness, pilosity.

To Stephen: the problem af den sacerdotal integrity of Jesus
circumcised (1 January, holiday of obligation to hear mass og abstain
fra unnecessary servile work) og the problem as to whether the divine
prepuce, the carnal bridal ring af den holy Roman catholic apostolic
church, conserved in Calcata, were deserving of simple hyperduly eller of
the fourth degree of latria accorded til den abscission of such divine
excrescences as hair og toenails.
hvad celestial sign was by both simultaneously observed?

A stjerne precipitated med great apparent velocity across the firmament
fra Vega i den Lyre above the zenith beyond the stargroup af den
Tress of Berenice towards the zodiacal sign of Leo.

hvordan did the centripetal remainer afford egress til den centrifugal
departer?

By inserting the barrel of an arruginated male key i den hole of an
unstable female lock, obtaining a purchase på den bow af den key og
turning its wards fra right to left, withdrawing a bolt fra its
staple, pulling inward spasmodically an obsolescent unhinged dør og
revealing an aperture for free egress og free ingress.
hvordan did they take leave, one af den other, in separation?

Standing perpendicular ved den same dør og on different sides of its
base, the lines of their valedictory arms, meeting at any point og
forming any angle less than the sum of two right angles.

hvad sound accompanied the union of their tangent, the disunion of
their (respectively) centrifugal og centripetal hands?

The sound af den peal af den hour af den nat ved den chime af den
bells i den church of Saint George.
hvad echoes of that sound were by both og each heard?
By Stephen:

Liliata rutilantium. Turma circumdet.
     Iubilantium te virginum. Chorus excipiat.
By Bloom:

Heigho, heigho,
     Heigho, heigho.

hvor were the several members af den company which med Bloom that dag
ved den bidding of that peal had travelled fra Sandymount i den south
to Glasnevin i den north?

Martin Cunningham (in bed), Jack Power (in bed), Simon Dedalus (in
bed), Ned Lambert (in bed), Tom Kernan (in bed), Joe Hynes (in bed),
John Henry Menton (in bed), Bernard Corrigan (in bed), Patsy Dignam (in
bed), Paddy Dignam (i den grave).
Alone, hvad did Bloom hear?

The double reverberation of retreating feet på den heavenborn jord,
the double vibration of a jew’s harp i den resonant lane.
Alone, hvad did Bloom feel?

The cold of interstellar space, thousands of degrees below freezing
point eller the absolute zero of Fahrenheit, Centigrade eller Réaumur: the
incipient intimations of proximate dawn.

Of hvad did bellchime og handtouch og footstep og lonechill remind
him?

Of companions nu in various manners in different places defunct: Percy
Apjohn (killed in action, Modder River), Philip Gilligan (phthisis,
Jervis gade hospital), Matthew F. Kane (accidental drowning, Dublin
Bay), Philip Moisel (pyemia, Heytesbury gade), Michael Hart
(phthisis, Mater Misericordiae hospital), Patrick Dignam (apoplexy,
Sandymount).
hvad prospect of hvad phenomena inclined him to remain?

The disparition of three final stjerner, the diffusion of daybreak, the
apparition of a ny solar disk.
Had he ever been a spectator of those phenomena?

Once, in 1887, efter a protracted performance of charades i den hus
of Luke Doyle, Kimmage, han havde awaited med patience the apparition of
the diurnal phenomenon, seated on a wall, his gaze turned i den
direction of Mizrach, the east.
He remembered the initial paraphenomena?

mere active air, a matutinal distant cock, ecclesiastical clocks at
various points, avine musik, the isolated tread of an early wayfarer,
the visible diffusion af den lys of an invisible luminous krop, the
first golden limb af den resurgent sol perceptible low på den horizon.
Did he remain?

med deep inspiration he returned, retraversing the garden, reentering
the passage, reclosing the dør. med brief suspiration he reassumed
the candle, reascended the stairs, reapproached the dør af den front
rum, hallfloor, og reentered.
hvad suddenly arrested his ingress?

The right temporal lobe af den hollow sphere of his cranium came ind i
contact med a solid timber angle hvor, an infinitesimal men sensible
fraction of a second later, a painful sensation was located in
consequence of antecedent sensations transmitted og registered.

Describe the alterations effected i den disposition af den articles of
furniture.

A sofa upholstered in prune plush had been translocated fra opposite
the dør til den ingleside near the compactly furled Union Jack (an
alteration which han havde frequently intended to execute): the blue og
white checker inlaid majolicatopped table had been placed opposite the
dør i den place vacated ved den prune plush sofa: the walnut sideboard
(a projecting angle of which had momentarily arrested his ingress) had
been moved fra its position beside the dør to a mere advantageous men
mere perilous position in front af den dør: two chairs had been moved
fra right og left af den ingleside til den position originally
occupied ved den blue og white checker inlaid majolicatopped table.
Describe them.

One: a squat stuffed easychair, med stout arms extended og back
slanted til den rere, which, repelled in recoil, had så upturned an
irregular fringe of a rectangular rug og nu displayed on its amply
upholstered seat a centralised diffusing og diminishing
discolouration. The other: a slender splayfoot chair of glossy cane
curves, placed directly opposite the former, its frame fra top to seat
og fra seat to base being varnished mørk brown, its seat being a
bright circle of white plaited rush.
hvad significances attached to these two chairs?

Significances of similitude, of posture, of symbolism, of
circumstantial evidence, of testimonial supermanence.
hvad occupied the position originally occupied ved den sideboard?

A vertical piano (Cadby) med exposed keyboard, its closed coffin
supporting a pair of lang yellow ladies’ gloves og an emerald ashtray
containing four consumed matches, a partly consumed cigarette og two
discoloured ends of cigarettes, its musicrest supporting the musik in
the key of G natural for stemme og piano of _Love’s gammel Sweet Song_
(words by G. Clifton Bingham, composed by J. L. Molloy, sung by Madam
Antoinette Sterling) open ved den last page med den final indications
_ad libitum, forte_, pedal, _animato_, sustained pedal, _ritirando_,
close.
med hvad sensations did Bloom contemplate in rotation these objects?

med strain, elevating a candlestick: med pain, feeling on his right
temple a contused tumescence: med attention, focussing his gaze on a
large dull passive og a slender bright active: med solicitation,
bending og downturning the upturned rugfringe: med amusement,
remembering Dr Malachi Mulligan’s scheme of colour containing the
gradation of green: med pleasure, repeating the words og antecedent
act og perceiving through various channels of internal sensibility the
consequent og concomitant tepid pleasant diffusion of gradual
discolouration.
His next proceeding?

fra an open box på den majolicatopped table he extracted a black
diminutive cone, one inch in height, placed it on its circular base on
a small tin plate, placed his candlestick på den right corner af den
mantelpiece, produced fra his waistcoat a folded page of prospectus
(illustrated) entitled Agendath Netaim, unfolded the same, examined it
superficially, rolled it ind i a thin cylinder, ignited it i den
candleflame, applied it da ignited til den apex af den cone till the
latter reached the stage of rutilance, placed the cylinder i den basin
af den candlestick disposing its unconsumed part in such a manner as to
facilitate total combustion.
hvad followed this operation?

The truncated conical crater summit af den diminutive volcano emitted a
vertical og serpentine fume redolent of aromatic oriental incense.

hvad homothetic objects, other than the candlestick, stood på den
mantelpiece?

A timepiece of striated Connemara marble, stopped ved den hour of 4.46
a.m. på den 21 March 1896, matrimonial gift of Matthew Dillon: a dwarf
træ of glacial arborescence under a transparent bellshade, matrimonial
gift of Luke og Caroline Doyle: an embalmed owl, matrimonial gift of
Alderman John Hooper.

hvad interchanges of looks took place between these three objects og
Bloom?

i den mirror af den giltbordered pierglass the undecorated back af den
dwarf træ regarded the upright back af den embalmed owl. før the
mirror the matrimonial gift of Alderman John Hooper med a clear
melancholy wise bright motionless compassionate gaze regarded Bloom
while Bloom med obscure tranquil profound motionless compassionated
gaze regarded the matrimonial gift of Luke og Caroline Doyle.

hvad composite asymmetrical image i den mirror så attracted his
attention?
The image of a solitary (ipsorelative) mutable (aliorelative) mand.
hvorfor solitary (ipsorelative)?

Brothers og sisters had he none.
     Yet that mand’s far was his grandfather’s søn.
hvorfor mutable (aliorelative)?

fra infancy to maturity han havde resembled his maternal procreatrix.
fra maturity to senility han ville increasingly resemble his paternal
procreator.
hvad final visual impression was communicated to him ved den mirror?

The optical reflection of several inverted volumes improperly arranged
og ikke i den order of their common letters med scintillating titles
på den two bookshelves opposite.

hvad reflections occupied his sind during the process of reversion of
the inverted volumes?

The necessity of order, a place for alt og alt in its
place: the deficient appreciation of literature possessed by females:
the incongruity of an apple incuneated in a tumbler og of an umbrella
inclined in a closestool: the insecurity of hiding any secret document
behind, beneath eller between the pages of a book.
Which volume was the largest in bulk?
Hozier’s _History af den Russo-Turkish War._

hvad among other data did the second volume af den work in question
contain?

The name of a decisive battle (forgotten), frequently remembered by a
decisive officer, major Brian Cooper Tweedy (remembered).
hvorfor, firstly og secondly, did he ikke consult the work in question?

Firstly, in order to exercise mnemotechnic: secondly, because efter an
interval of amnesia, da, seated ved den central table, om to
consult the work in question, he remembered by mnemotechnic the name of
the military engagement, Plevna.
hvad caused him consolation in his sitting posture?

The candour, nudity, pose, tranquility, youth, grace, sex, counsel of a
statue erect i den centre af den table, an image of Narcissus
purchased by auction fra P. A. Wren, 9 Bachelor’s Walk.
hvad caused him irritation in his sitting posture?

Inhibitory pressure of collar (size 17) og waistcoat (5 buttons), two
articles of clothing superfluous i den costume of mature males og
inelastic to alterations of mass by expansion.
hvordan was the irritation allayed?

He removed his collar, med contained black necktie og collapsible
stud, fra his neck to a position på den left af den table. He
unbuttoned successively in reversed direction waistcoat, trousers,
shirt og vest along the medial line of irregular incrispated black
hairs extending in triangular convergence fra den pelvic basin over
the circumference af den abdomen og umbilicular fossicle along the
medial line of nodes til den intersection af den sixth pectoral
vertebrae, thence produced both ways at right angles og terminating in
circles described om two equidistant points, right og left, på den
summits af den mammary prominences. He unbraced successively each of
six minus one braced trouser buttons, arranged in pairs, of which one
incomplete.
hvad involuntary actions followed?

He compressed between 2 fingers the flesh circumjacent to a cicatrice
i den left infracostal region below the diaphragm resulting fra a
sting inflicted 2 weeks og 3 days previously (23 May 1904) by a bee.
He scratched imprecisely med his right hånd, though insensible of
prurition, various points og surfaces of his partly exposed, wholly
abluted skin. He inserted his left hånd ind i den left lower pocket of
his waistcoat og extracted og replaced a silver coin (1 shilling),
placed der (presumably) på den occasion (17 October 1903) af den
interment of Mrs Emily Sinico, Sydney Parade.

Did the process of divestiture continue?

Sensible of a benignant persistent ache in his footsoles he extended
his foot to one side og observed the creases, protuberances og
salient points caused by foot pressure i den course of walking
repeatedly in several different directions, så, inclined, he disnoded
the laceknots, unhooked og loosened the laces, took off each of his
two boots for the second tid, detached the partially moistened right
sock gennem den fore part of which the nail of his great toe had igen
effracted, raised his right foot og, having unhooked a purple elastic
sock suspender, took off his right sock, placed his unclothed right
foot på den margin af den seat of his chair, picked at og gently
lacerated the protruding part af den great toenail, raised the part
lacerated to his nostrils og inhaled the odour af den quick, så,
med satisfaction, threw away the lacerated ungual fragment.
hvorfor med satisfaction?

Because the odour inhaled corresponded to other odours inhaled of other
ungual fragments, picked og lacerated by Master Bloom, pupil of Mrs
Ellis’s juvenile school, patiently each nat i den act of brief
genuflection og nocturnal prayer og ambitious meditation.

In hvad ultimate ambition had alle concurrent og consecutive ambitions
nu coalesced?

ikke to inherit by right of primogeniture, gavelkind eller borough English,
eller possess in perpetuity an extensive demesne of a sufficient number of
acres, roods og perches, statute land measure (valuation £ 42), of
grazing turbary surrounding a baronial hall med gatelodge og carriage
drive nor, på den other hånd, a terracehouse eller semidetached villa,
described as _Rus in Urbe_ eller _Qui si sana_, men to purchase by private
treaty in fee simple a thatched bungalowshaped 2 storey dwellinghouse
of southerly aspect, surmounted by vane og lightning conductor,
connected med den jord, med porch covered by parasitic plants (ivy
eller Virginia creeper), halldoor, olive green, med smart carriage finish
og neat doorbrasses, stucco front med gilt tracery at eaves og
gable, rising, if possible, upon a gentle eminence med agreeable
prospect fra balcony med sten pillar parapet over unoccupied og
unoccupyable interjacent pastures og standing in 5 eller 6 acres of its
own ground, at such a distance fra den nearest public thoroughfare as
to render its houselights visible at nat above og through a quickset
hornbeam hedge of topiary cutting, situate at a given point ikke less
than 1 statute mile fra den periphery af den metropolis, within a tid
limit of ikke mere than 15 minutes fra tram eller train line (e.g.,
Dundrum, south, eller Sutton, north, both localities equally reported by
trial to resemble the terrestrial poles in being favourable climates
for phthisical subjects), the premises to be held under feefarm grant,
lease 999 years, the messuage to consist of 1 drawingroom med
baywindow (2 lancets), thermometer affixed, 1 sittingroom, 4 bedrooms,
2 servants’ rooms, tiled kitchen med close range og scullery, lounge
hall fitted med linen wallpresses, fumed oak sectional bookcase
containing the Encyclopaedia Britannica og ny Century Dictionary,
transverse obsolete medieval og oriental weapons, dinner gong,
alabaster lamp, bowl pendant, vulcanite automatic telephone receiver
med adjacent directory, handtufted Axminster carpet med cream ground
og trellis border, loo table med pillar og claw legs, hearth med
massive firebrasses og ormolu mantel chronometer clock, guaranteed
timekeeper med cathedral chime, barometer med hygrographic chart,
comfortable lounge settees og corner fitments, upholstered in ruby
plush med gud springing og sunk centre, three banner Japanese screen
og cuspidors (club style, rich winecoloured leather, gloss renewable
med a minimum of labour by use of linseed oil og vinegar) og
pyramidically prismatic central chandelier lustre, bentwood perch med
fingertame parrot (expurgated language), embossed mural paper at 10/-
per dozen med transverse swags of carmine floral design og top crown
frieze, staircase, three continuous flights at successive right angles,
of varnished cleargrained oak, treads og risers, newel, balusters og
handrail, med steppedup panel dado, dressed med camphorated wax:
bathroom, hot og cold supply, reclining og shower: vand closet on
mezzanine provided med opaque singlepane oblong window, tipup seat,
bracket lamp, brass tierod og brace, armrests, footstool og artistic
oleograph on inner ansigt of dør: ditto, plain: servants’ apartments
med separate sanitary og hygienic necessaries for cook, general og
betweenmaid (salary, rising by biennial unearned increments of £ 2,
med comprehensive fidelity insurance, annual bonus (£ 1) og retiring
allowance (based på den 65 system) efter 30 years’ service), pantry,
buttery, larder, refrigerator, outoffices, coal og wood cellarage med
winebin (stadig og sparkling vintages) for distinguished guests, if
entertained to dinner (evening dress), carbon monoxide gas supply
throughout.
hvad additional attractions might the grounds contain?

As addenda, a tennis og fives court, a shrubbery, a glass summerhouse
med tropical palms, equipped i den best botanical manner, a rockery
med waterspray, a beehive arranged on humane principles, oval
flowerbeds in rectangular grassplots set med eccentric ellipses of
scarlet og chrome tulips, blue scillas, crocuses, polyanthus, sweet
William, sweet pea, lily af den valley (bulbs obtainable fra sir James
W. Mackey (Limited) wholesale og retail seed og bulb merchants og
nurserymen, agents for chemical manures, 23 Sackville gade, upper),
an orchard, kitchen garden og vinery, protected against illegal
trespassers by glasstopped mural enclosures, a lumbershed med padlock
for various inventoried implements.
As?

Eeltraps, lobsterpots, fishingrods, hatchet, steelyard, grindstone,
clodcrusher, swatheturner, carriagesack, telescope ladder, 10 tooth
rake, washing clogs, haytedder, tumbling rake, billhook, paintpot,
brush, hoe og so on.
hvad improvements might be subsequently introduced?

A rabbitry og fowlrun, a dovecote, a botanical conservatory, 2
hammocks (lady’s og gentleman’s), a sundial shaded og sheltered by
laburnum eller lilac trees, an exotically harmonically accorded Japanese
tinkle gatebell affixed to left lateral gatepost, a capacious
waterbutt, a lawnmower med side delivery og grassbox, a lawnsprinkler
med hydraulic hose.
hvad facilities of transit were desirable?

da citybound frequent connection by train eller tram fra their
respective intermediate station eller terminal. da countrybound
velocipedes, a chainless freewheel roadster cycle med side basketcar
attached, eller draught conveyance, a donkey med wicker trap eller smart
phaeton med gud working solidungular cob (roan gelding, 14 h).
hvad might be the name of this erigible eller erected residence?
Bloom Cottage. Saint Leopold’s. Flowerville.
Could Bloom of 7 Eccles gade foresee Bloom of Flowerville?

In loose allwool garments med Harris tweed cap, price 8/6, og useful
garden boots med elastic gussets og wateringcan, planting aligned
young firtrees, syringing, pruning, staking, sowing hayseed, trundling
a weedladen wheelbarrow without excessive fatigue at sunset amid the
scent of newmown hay, ameliorating the soil, multiplying wisdom,
achieving longevity.
hvad syllabus of intellectual pursuits was simultaneously possible?

Snapshot photography, comparative study of religions, folklore relative
to various amatory og superstitious practices, contemplation af den
celestial constellations.
hvad lighter recreations?

Outdoor: garden og fieldwork, cycling on level macadamised causeways,
ascents of moderately high hills, natation in secluded fresh vand og
unmolested river boating in secure wherry eller lys curricle med kedge
anchor on reaches free fra weirs og rapids (period of estivation),
vespertinal perambulation eller equestrian circumprocession med
inspection of sterile landscape og contrastingly agreeable cottagers’
fires of smoking peat turves (period of hibernation). Indoor:
discussion in tepid security of unsolved historical og criminal
problems: lecture of unexpurgated exotic erotic masterpieces: hus
carpentry med toolbox containing hammer, awl, nails, screws, tintacks,
gimlet, tweezers, bullnose plane og turnscrew.
Might he become a gentleman farmer of field produce og live stock?

ikke impossibly, med 1 eller 2 stripper cows, 1 pike of upland hay og
requisite farming implements, e.g., an end-to-end churn, a turnip
pulper etc.

hvad would be his civic functions og social status among the county
families og landed gentry?

Arranged successively in ascending powers of hierarchical order, that
of gardener, groundsman, cultivator, breeder, og ved den zenith of his
career, resident magistrate eller justice af den peace med a family crest
og coat of arms og appropriate classical motto _(Semper paratus_),
duly recorded i den court directory (Bloom, Leopold P., M. P., P. C.,
K. P., L. L. D. (_honoris causa_), Bloomville, Dundrum) og mentioned
in court og fashionable intelligence (Mr og Mrs Leopold Bloom have
left Kingstown for England).
hvad course of action did he outline for himself in such capacity?

A course that lay between undue clemency og excessive rigour: the
dispensation in a heterogeneous society of arbitrary classes,
incessantly rearranged in terms of greater og lesser social
inequality, of unbiassed homogeneous indisputable justice, tempered
med mitigants af den widest possible latitude men exactable til den
uttermost farthing med confiscation of estate, real og personal, to
the crown. Loyal til den highest constituted power i den land, actuated
by an innate kærlighed of rectitude his aims would be the strict maintenance
of public order, the repression of mange abuses though ikke of alle
simultaneously (hver measure of reform eller retrenchment being a
preliminary solution to be contained by fluxion i den final solution),
the upholding af den letter af den law (common, statute og law
merchant) against alle traversers in covin og trespassers acting in
contravention of bylaws og regulations, alle resuscitators (by trespass
og petty larceny of kindlings) of venville rights, obsolete by
desuetude, alle orotund instigators of international persecution, alle
perpetuators of international animosities, alle menial molestors of
domestic conviviality, alle recalcitrant violators of domestic
connubiality.
Prove that han havde loved rectitude fra his earliest youth.

To Master Percy Apjohn at High School in 1880 han havde divulged his
disbelief i den tenets af den Irish (protestant) church (to which his
far Rudolf Virag (later Rudolph Bloom) had been converted fra den
Israelitic faith og communion in 1865 ved den Society for promoting
Christianity among the jews) subsequently abjured by him in favour of
Roman catholicism ved den epoch of og med a view to his matrimony in
1888. To Daniel Magrane og Francis Wade in 1882 during a juvenile
friendship (terminated ved den premature emigration af den former) he
had advocated during nocturnal perambulations the political theory of
colonial (e.g. Canadian) expansion og the evolutionary theories of
Charles Darwin, expounded in _The Descent of Man_ og _The Origin of
Species_. In 1885 han havde publicly expressed his adherence til den
collective og national economic programme advocated by James Fintan
Lalor, John Fisher Murray, John Mitchel, J. F. X. O’Brien og others,
the agrarian policy of Michael Davitt, the constitutional agitation of
Charles Stewart Parnell (M. P. for Cork City), the programme of peace,
retrenchment og reform of William Ewart Gladstone (M. P. for
Midlothian, N. B.) og, in support of his political convictions, had
climbed up ind i a secure position amid the ramifications of a træ on
Northumberland road to see the entrance (2 February 1888) ind i den
capital of a demonstrative torchlight procession of 20,000
torchbearers, divided ind i 120 trade corporations, bearing 2000 torches
in escort af den marquess of Ripon og (honest) John Morley.
hvordan meget og hvordan did he propose to pay for this country residence?

As per prospectus af den Industrious Foreign Acclimatised Nationalised
Friendly Stateaided Building Society (incorporated 1874), a maximum of
£ 60 per annum, being 1/6 of an assured income, derived fra giltedged
securities, representing at 5 % simple interest on capital of £ 1200
(estimate of price at 20 years’ purchase), of which 1/3 to be paid on
acquisition og the balance i den form of annual rent, viz. £ 800 plus
2 1/2 % interest på den same, repayable quarterly in equal annual
instalments until extinction by amortisation of loan advanced for
purchase within a period of 20 years, amounting to an annual rental of
£ 64, headrent included, the titledeeds to remain in possession af den
lender eller lenders med a saving clause envisaging forced sale,
foreclosure og mutual compensation i den event of protracted failure
to pay the terms assigned, otherwise the messuage to become the
absolute property af den tenant occupier upon expiry af den period of
years stipulated.

hvad eventuality would render him independent of such wealth?
The independent discovery of a goldseam of inexhaustible ore.
For hvad reason did he meditate on schemes so difficult of realisation?

det var one of his axioms that similar meditations eller the automatic

His justifications?

As a physicist han havde learned that af den 70 years of complete human

hvad did he fear?

The committal of homicide eller suicide during sleep by an aberration of
the lys of reason, the incommensurable categorical intelligence
situated i den cerebral convolutions.
hvad were habitually his final meditations?

Of nogle one sole unique advertisement to cause passers to stop in
wonder, a poster novelty, med alle extraneous accretions excluded,

hvordan did absentminded beggar’s concluding testimonial conclude?

A 4th typewritten letter received by Henry blomst (let H. F. be L. B.)

The reflection that, apart fra den letter in question, his magnetic

The possibility of exercising virile power of fascination i den ikke

Quote the textual terms of this notice.

hvad other objects relative to Rudolph Bloom (born Virag) were i den

An indistinct daguerreotype of Rudolf Virag og his far Leopold

hvad fractions of phrases did the lecture of those five whole words

Tomorrow will be a week that I received... it is nej use Leopold to be
... med your dear mor... that er ikke mere to stand... to her... alle

hvad reminiscences of a human subject suffering fra progressive
melancholia did these objects evoke in Bloom?

An gammel mand, widower, unkempt of hair, in bed, med hoved covered,

hvorfor did Bloom experience a sentiment of remorse?

Because in immature impatience han havde treated med disrespect certain
beliefs og practices.
As?

The prohibition af den use of fleshmeat og milk at one meal: the
hebdomadary symposium of incoordinately abstract, perfervidly concrete

infants: the supernatural character of Judaic scripture: the
ineffability af den tetragrammaton: the sanctity af den sabbath.
hvordan did these beliefs og practices nu appear to him?

ikke mere rational than de havde så appeared, ikke less rational than
other beliefs og practices nu appeared.
hvad first reminiscence had he of Rudolph Bloom (deceased)?

Rudolph Bloom (deceased) narrated to his søn Leopold Bloom (aged 6) a
retrospective arrangement of migrations og settlements in og between
Dublin, London, Florence, Milan, Vienna, Budapest, Szombathely med
statements of satisfaction (his grandfather having seen Maria Theresia,
empress of Austria, queen of Hungary), med commercial advice (having
taken care of pence, the pounds having taken care of themselves).
Leopold Bloom (aged 6) had accompanied these narrations by constant
consultation of a geographical map of Europe (political) og by
suggestions for the establishment of affiliated business premises in
the various centres mentioned.

Had tid equally men differently obliterated the memory of these
migrations in narrator og listener?

In narrator ved den access of years og in consequence af den use of
narcotic toxin: in listener ved den access of years og in consequence
af den action of distraction upon vicarious experiences.

hvad idiosyncracies af den narrator were concomitant products of
amnesia?

Occasionally he ate without having previously removed his hat.
Occasionally he drank voraciously the juice of gooseberry fool fra an
inclined plate. Occasionally he removed fra his lips the traces of
food by means of a lacerated envelope eller other accessible fragment of
paper.
hvad two phenomena of senescence were mere frequent?

The myopic digital calculation of coins, eructation consequent upon
repletion.
hvad object offered partial consolation for these reminiscences?

The endowment policy, the bank passbook, the certificate af den
possession of scrip.

Reduce Bloom by cross multiplication of reverses of fortune, fra which
these supports protected him, og by elimination of alle positive values
to a negligible negative irrational unreal quantity.

Successively, in descending helotic order: Poverty: that af den outdoor
hawker of imitation jewellery, the dun for the recovery of dårlig og
doubtful debts, the poor rate og deputy cess collector. Mendicancy:
that af den fraudulent bankrupt med negligible assets paying 1/4d in
the £, sandwichman, distributor of throwaways, nocturnal vagrant,
insinuating sycophant, maimed sailor, blind stripling, superannuated
bailiff’s mand, marfeast, lickplate, spoilsport, pickthank, eccentric

Hospital), Kilmainham, the inmate of Simpson’s Hospital for reduced men
respectable men permanently disabled by gout eller want of sight. Nadir of
misery: the aged impotent disfranchised ratesupported moribund lunatic
pauper.
med which attendant indignities?

The unsympathetic indifference of previously amiable females, the
contempt of muscular males, the acceptance of fragments of bread, the
simulated ignorance of casual acquaintances, the latration of
illegitimate unlicensed vagabond dogs, the infantile discharge of
decomposed vegetable missiles, worth lille eller ingenting, ingenting eller less
than ingenting.
By hvad could such a situation be precluded?
By decease (change of state): by departure (change of place).
Which preferably?
The latter, ved den line of least resistance.
hvad considerations rendered departure ikke entirely undesirable?

Constant cohabitation impeding mutual toleration of personal defects.
The habit of independent purchase increasingly cultivated. The
necessity to counteract by impermanent sojourn the permanence of
arrest.
hvad considerations rendered departure ikke irrational?

The parties concerned, uniting, had increased og multiplied, which
being done, offspring produced og educed to maturity, the parties, if
ikke disunited were obliged to reunite for increase og multiplication,
which was absurd, to form by reunion the original couple of uniting
parties, which was impossible.
hvad considerations rendered departure desirable?

The attractive character of certain localities in Ireland og abroad,
as represented in general geographical maps of polychrome design eller in
special ordnance survey charts by employment of scale numerals og
hachures.
In Ireland?

The cliffs of Moher, the windy wilds of Connemara, lough Neagh med
submerged petrified city, the Giant’s Causeway, Fort Camden og Fort

pastures of royal Meath, Brigid’s elm in Kildare, the Queen’s Island

Abroad?

Ceylon (med spicegardens supplying tea to Thomas Kernan, agent for
Pulbrook, Robertson og Co, 2 Mincing Lane, London, E. C., 5 Dame

returns), the bay of Naples (to see which was to die), the Dead hav.
under hvad guidance, following hvad signs?

At hav, septentrional, by nat the polestar, located ved den point of
intersection af den right line fra beta to alpha in Ursa Maior
produced og divided externally at omega og the hypotenuse af den

hvad public advertisement would divulge the occultation af den
departed?

£ 5 reward, lost, stolen eller strayed fra his residence 7 Eccles gade,
missing gent om 40, answering til den name of Bloom, Leopold (Poldy),
height 5 ft 9 1/2 inches, full build, olive complexion, may have since
grown a beard, da last seen was wearing a black suit. Above sum will

hvad universal binomial denominations would be his as entity og

Assumed by any eller known to none. Everyman eller Noman.
hvad tributes his?

Honour og gifts of strangers, the friends of Everyman. A nymph
immortal, beauty, the bride of Noman.
Would the departed aldrig nowhere nohow reappear?

Ever han ville wander, selfcompelled, til den extreme limit of his
cometary orbit, beyond the fixed stjerner og variable suns og telescopic
planets, astronomical waifs og strays, til den extreme boundary of
space, passing fra land to land, among peoples, amid events. Somewhere
imperceptibly han ville hear og somehow reluctantly, suncompelled, obey
the summons of recall. Whence, disappearing fra den constellation of
the Northern Crown han ville somehow reappear reborn above delta i den
constellation of Cassiopeia og efter incalculable eons of
peregrination return an estranged avenger, a wreaker of justice on
malefactors, a mørk crusader, a sleeper awakened, med financial
resources (by supposition) surpassing those of Rothschild eller the silver
konge.
hvad would render such return irrational?

An unsatisfactory equation between an exodus og return in tid through
reversible space og an exodus og return in space through irreversible
tid.
hvad play of forces, inducing inertia, rendered departure undesirable?

The lateness af den hour, rendering procrastinatory: the obscurity of
the nat, rendering invisible: the uncertainty of thoroughfares,
rendering perilous: the necessity for repose, obviating movement: the
proximity of an occupied bed, obviating research: the anticipation of
warmth (human) tempered med coolness (linen), obviating desire og
rendering desirable: the statue of Narcissus, sound without echo,
desired desire.

hvad advantages were possessed by an occupied, as distinct fra an

The removal of nocturnal solitude, the superior quality of human

hvad selfimposed enigma did Bloom om to rise in order to go so as to

The cause of a brief sharp unforeseen heard loud lone crack emitted by

hvad selfinvolved enigma did Bloom risen, going, gathering
multicoloured multiform multitudinous garments, voluntarily

hvem was M’Intosh?

hvad selfevident enigma pondered med desultory constancy during 30

hvor was Moses da the candle went ud?

hvad imperfections in a perfect dag did Bloom, walking, charged med

A provisional failure to obtain renewal of an advertisement: to obtain

hvad impression of an absent ansigt did Bloom, arrested, silently recall?

The ansigt of her far, the late Major Brian Cooper Tweedy, Royal
