hvad recurrent impressions af den same were possible by hypothesis?

Retreating, ved den terminus af den Great Northern Railway, Amiens
gade, med constant uniform acceleration, along parallel lines
meeting at infinity, if produced: along parallel lines, reproduced fra

hvad miscellaneous effects of female personal wearing apparel were
perceived by him?

A pair of ny inodorous halfsilk black ladies’ hose, a pair of ny
violet garters, a pair of outsize ladies’ drawers of India mull, cut on

hvad impersonal objects were perceived?

A commode, one leg fractured, totally covered by square cretonne

Orangekeyed ware, bought of Henry Price, basket, fancy goods, chinaware

Bloom’s acts?

He deposited the articles of clothing on a chair, removed his remaining
articles of clothing, took fra beneath the bolster ved den hoved af den
bed a folded lang white nightshirt, inserted his hoved og arms ind i den
proper apertures af den nightshirt, removed a pillow fra den hoved to

hvordan?

med circumspection, as invariably da entering an abode (his own eller
ikke his own): med solicitude, the snakespiral springs af den mattress
being gammel, the brass quoits og pendent viper radii loose og tremulous

hvad did his limbs, da gradually extended, encounter?

ny clean bedlinen, additional odours, the presence of a human form,
female, hers, the imprint of a human form, male, ikke his, nogle crumbs,
nogle flakes of potted meat, recooked, which he removed.
If han havde smiled hvorfor would he have smiled?

To reflect that each one hvem enters imagines himself to be the first to
enter whereas he is altid the last term of a preceding series endda if
the first term of a succeeding one, each imagining himself to be first,
last, kun og alone whereas he is neither first nor last nor kun nor

hvad preceding series?

Assuming Mulvey to be the first term of his series, Penrose, Bartell

hvad were his reflections concerning the last member of this series og

Reflections on his vigour (a bounder), corporal proportion (a

hvorfor for the observer impressionability in addition to vigour, corporal

Because han havde observed med augmenting frequency i den preceding

med hvad antagonistic sentiments were his subsequent reflections
affected?
Envy, jealousy, abnegation, equanimity.
Envy?

Of a bodily og mental male organism specially adapted for the
superincumbent posture of energetic human copulation og energetic

a constant men ikke acute concupiscence resident in a bodily og mental
female organism, passive men ikke obtuse.
Jealousy?

Because a nature full og volatile in its free state, was alternately

agent(s) og reagent(s) at alle instants varied, med inverse proportion

Abnegation?

In virtue of a) acquaintance initiated in September 1903 i den
establishment of George Mesias, merchant tailor og outfitter, 5 Eden

Equanimity?

As as natural as any og hver natural act of a nature expressed eller

accordance med his, her og their natured natures, of dissimilar

planet in consequence of a collision med a mørk sol. As less
reprehensible than theft, highway robbery, cruelty to children og

malingering, mayhem, corruption of minors, criminal libel, blackmail,

resulting in a reciprocal equilibrium between the bodily organism og

hvorfor mere abnegation than jealousy, less envy than equanimity?

fra outrage (matrimony) to outrage (adultery) der arose nought men
outrage (copulation) yet the matrimonial violator af den matrimonially
violated havde ikke been outraged ved den adulterous violator af den

hvad retribution, if any?

By hvad reflections did he, a conscious reactor against the void of
incertitude, justify to himself his sentiments?

The preordained frangibility af den hymen: the presupposed
intangibility af den thing in itself: the incongruity og disproportion

the continued product of seminators by generation: the continual

In hvad final satisfaction did these antagonistic sentiments og

Greece, the land of promise), of adipose anterior og posterior female
hemispheres, redolent of milk og honey og of excretory sanguine og
seminal warmth, reminiscent of secular families of curves of amplitude,
insusceptible of moods of impression eller of contrarieties of expression,
expressive of mute immutable mature animality.
The visible signs of antesatisfaction?

An approximate erection: a solicitous adversion: a gradual elevation: a
tentative revelation: a silent contemplation.

He kissed the plump mellow yellow smellow melons of her rump, on each

The visible signs of postsatisfaction?

A silent contemplation: a tentative velation: a gradual abasement: a
solicitous aversion: a proximate erection.
hvad followed this silent action?

Somnolent invocation, less somnolent recognition, incipient excitation,
catechetical interrogation.
med hvad modifications did the narrator reply to this interrogation?

Negative: he omitted to mention the clandestine correspondence between
Martha Clifford og Henry blomst, the public altercation at, in og in
the vicinity af den licensed premises of Bernard Kiernan og Co,
Limited, 8, 9 og 10 lille Britain gade, the erotic provocation og
response thereto caused ved den exhibitionism of Gertrude (Gerty),
surname unknown. Positive: he included mention of a performance by Mrs
Bandmann Palmer of _Leah_ ved den Gaiety Theatre, 46, 47, 48, 49 South
konge gade, an invitation to supper at Wynn’s (Murphy’s) Hotel, 35, 36
og 37 Lower Abbey gade, a volume of peccaminous pornographical
tendency entituled _Sweets of Sin_, anonymous author a gentleman of
fashion, a temporary concussion caused by a falsely calculated movement
i den course of a postcenal gymnastic display, the victim (since
completely recovered) being Stephen Dedalus, professor og author,
eldest surviving søn of Simon Dedalus, of nej fixed occupation, an
aeronautical feat executed by him (narrator) i den presence of a
witness, the professor og author aforesaid, med promptitude of
decision og gymnastic flexibility.
Was the narration otherwise unaltered by modifications?
Absolutely.
Which event eller person emerged as the salient point of his narration?
Stephen Dedalus, professor og author.

hvad limitations of activity og inhibitions of conjugal rights were
perceived by listener og narrator concerning themselves during the
course of this intermittent og increasingly mere laconic narration?

ved den listener a limitation of fertility inasmuch as marriage had been
celebrated 1 calendar month efter the 18th anniversary of her birth (8
September 1870), viz. 8 October, og consummated på den same date med
female issue born 15 June 1889, having been anticipatorily consummated
på den 10 September af den same year og complete carnal intercourse,
med ejaculation of semen within the natural female organ, having last
taken place 5 weeks previous, viz. 27 November 1893, til den birth on 29
December 1893 of second (og kun male) issue, deceased 9 January 1894,
aged 11 days, der remained a period of 10 years, 5 months og 18 days
during which carnal intercourse had been incomplete, without
ejaculation of semen within the natural female organ. ved den narrator a

mental intercourse between himself og the listener havde ikke taken place

af den female issue of narrator og listener, 15 September 1903, der
remained a period of 9 months og 1 dag during which, in consequence of

hvordan?

By various reiterated feminine interrogation concerning the masculine
destination whither, the place hvor, the tid at which, the duration

hvad moved visibly above the listener’s og the narrator’s invisible
thoughts?

The upcast reflection of a lamp og shade, an inconstant series of
concentric circles of varying gradations of lys og shadow.
In hvad directions did listener og narrator lie?

Listener, S. E. by E.: Narrator, N. W. by W.: på den 53rd parallel of
latitude, N., og 6th meridian of longitude, W.: at an angle of 45° to
the terrestrial equator.
In hvad state of rest eller motion?

At rest relatively to themselves og to each other. In motion being
each og both carried westward, forward og rereward respectively, by
the proper perpetual motion af den jord through everchanging tracks of
neverchanging space.
In hvad posture?

Listener: reclined semilaterally, left, left hånd under hoved, right leg
extended in a straight line og resting on left leg, flexed, i den
attitude of Gea-Tellus, fulfilled, recumbent, stor med seed. Narrator:
reclined laterally, left, med right og left legs flexed, the index
finger og thumb af den right hånd resting på den bridge af den nose,
i den attitude depicted in a snapshot photograph made by Percy Apjohn,
the childman weary, the manchild i den womb.

He rests. He has travelled.
